items.statement: E30 blending timeline may be delayed 6-12 months due to social media protests; E20 is irreversible
items.quote: The increasing blending beyond 20% may be delayed by 6 months to 1 year until these unnecessary social media noise settles down. But E20 is definitely here to stay.

items.statement: Next growth phase from FY28: specialty and import-substitute chemicals in grain processing segment; products under evaluation, R&D ongoing
items.quote: As we have shared earlier, beginning in FY28, we intend to expand into specialty and import-substitute chemicals. Our objective is to build businesses with strong entry barriers, lower cyclicality, and higher value addition. The products are currently under evaluation, and once finalized, we will share details with all

items.statement: On-site plant at Trident expected operational by end of FY27, adding incremental revenue
items.quote: I would also like to add that our on-site plant at Trident should also be operational by the end of this financial year. That will definitely generate some additional revenue.

items.statement: Management projects high single-digit revenue growth for FY27, maintaining prior guidance despite market softness from geopolitical uncertainty.
items.quote: So, we have projected a high single-digit growth in our guidance. We are maintaining that. There is still a degree of softness in the market because of the war and the uncertainties.

items.statement: Targets INR 3,000 crores revenue in 3-year window (from current ~INR 2,000 crores) via organic and inorganic growth.
items.quote: Yes. So, we are looking at about a 3-year window of about INR 3,000-odd crores. We are about INR 2,000 crores right now roughly. So, we are looking at roughly in that range.

items.statement: Expects ~0.5% EBITDA margin improvement in FY27, targeting closer to 20% for the full year.
items.quote: So, across the board, we are at about 19-odd percent EBITDA margin. We are looking at about, roughly 0.5% improvement in this financial year. So, we should be hitting closer to 20% this financial year.

items.statement: Will sustain AI R&D investment at INR 40-50 crores for FY27; next year's budget undecided due to rapid AI evolution.
items.quote: We will keep it at approximately the same level because right now, there's a lot happening in that space, and we need to keep abreast with what's happening with latest technology, plus we are investing in the platform that we are building.

items.statement: AI-led deals constitute ~60% of wins in current fiscal year, driving higher conversion rates.
items.quote: If you look at the current financial year, about 60% of the deals we won have been AI-led or largely AI-driven. So, we see a good conversion ratio there.

items.statement: Strong traction for AI platforms (KAi underwriting, KAiSDLC, KAiBRE, SuperCX) with legacy modernization projects compressing timelines from years to months.
items.quote: We are seeing a good traction we are getting on the KAi underwriting solution and the KAiSDLC and KAiBRE solutions. These are for enterprise modernization. We have kicked off some projects in that space already.

items.statement: First customer booked for AI underwriting product; more deals expected soon in insurance sector across India, US, and Europe.
items.quote: We have started booking. We've got the first customer. We'll have a few more very soon.

items.statement: Actively evaluating M&A targets; no matured conversations to disclose. Cash position of INR 710 crores (pre-TNQTech payout).
items.quote: We are in dialogue with some companies from an M&A point of view. And no conversation has matured to the level that we need to sort of report it, but we are in dialogue with some companies.

items.statement: Deal sizes increasing but shifting to shorter-tenure transformation projects (3-9 months) vs traditional 3-5 year annuity deals.
items.quote: So, actually, our deal sizes are going up. It's just that they're not the annuity types. The deal size have actually gone up. But margins are where they are.

items.statement: No major shift in customer spending patterns across verticals/geographies; clients experimenting more with AI/automation but overall softness persists.
items.quote: No major changes. They are flirting more with the AI space. So, they are investing more on automation. But outside of that, there's no really pattern shift other than some degree of softness that we see.

items.statement: Board approved preferential issue in HT Media and Digicontent to retire 30-50% of debt, improve EPS and credit rating; priced per SEBI formula at INR 24.7
items.quote: Once the preferential capital comes in, the money will be used to retire the debt. At least 30 % to 50% of the debt will be retired, which will definitely be accretive to the EPS and long-term interest coverage ratio, our credit rating and so on and so forth.

items.statement: Preferential issue chosen over rights issue for faster execution (2-3 months), certainty of fundraising, and no under-subscription risk
items.quote: Preferential issue is a slightly shorter process. There is greater certainty of fundraising because there was a quantum that was being targeted to reduce the debt.

items.statement: Print EBITDA margin at 13% in Q1 FY27; management says it can be used as baseline for modelling if newsprint prices don't worsen
items.quote: So by and large, in your modelling, you can use that, but I told you what the imponderables are.

items.statement: Newsprint prices peaked at $650-700/metric ton, expected to plateau then decline; weak rupee adds cost pressure; no forward hedging available
items.quote: We believe that the prices have peaked and should plateau at this level before they start coming down. But obviously, as a commodity, no one can predict, that's our best estimate.

items.statement: Print ad revenue growth of 15% driven substantially by yield/pricing improvements; government ad rates increased in Nov 2025 after seven years
items.quote: A substantial part of that revenue growth of 15% is driven by our pricing. Of course, Government gave a price increase in November last year, but that was after seven years.

items.statement: Commercial print ad volumes held steady; government ad revenue grew on both volume and pricing; circulation steady with no drastic copy or price changes
items.quote: We have seen commercial revenues holding from a volume perspective. We have had a benefit of yield improvement there.

items.statement: Digital revenue down 28% YoY as portfolio deliberately reset to leaner, profitable offerings; Radio revenue flat after surrendering non-viable licenses
items.quote: Digital revenue moderated during the quarter as we deliberately reset the portfolio around leaner, more focused offerings with the intent of driving sustainable and profitable growth.

items.statement: Elevated newsprint prices, weaker rupee, and global supply chain uncertainties cited as concerns for Print margins going forward
items.quote: However, elevated newsprint prices, a weaker rupee, and global supply chain uncertainties are causes for concern going forward.

items.statement: No specific capex guidance given; focus on cost discipline and right-sizing organization driving employee cost reduction from INR 111 cr to INR 99 cr YoY
items.quote: We've been driving efficiency. I think that's something that we've been saying for the past sometime. We've been right-sizing the organization and that's basically what it is.

items.statement: Consolidated net cash INR 922 cr but sits in HMVL; HT Media and Digicontent are net debt companies; preferential issue only at those entities
items.quote: We have a very substantially healthy balance sheet position with net cash at INR 922 crores. But you have to understand that all that cash is parked in HMVL.

items.statement: Management expects traditional media (Radio, TV, Print) to remain subdued in FY27; Events business to grow exponentially; Digital (Gaana) targeting breakeven this year
items.quote: So we believe this year, the traditional mediums of Radio, TV, Print will remain subdued, the pure radio advertising. Events business will grow, exponentially has been growing across the board, and we continue to be bullish about it.

items.statement: Radio EBITDA margins historically 35-40%; Events EBITDA margins 25-30%; Gaana losses reduced 15% YoY to INR 8.3 cr, targeting breakeven
items.quote: So if you look at, our radio margins have always been in the range of 35% to 40%. Events have been in the range of 25% to 30% EBITDA margin. So you can look at in those lines as the profitability margin numbers.

items.statement: Radio advertising demand remains soft due to macro uncertainties and media fragmentation; Digital revenue grew 43.3% YoY to INR 31.1 cr (30.2% of total); Gaana revenue up 19% YoY to INR 21.4 cr
items.quote: The challenging conditions witnessed in FY26 extended into Q1 FY27 with advertiser demand remaining soft due to the uncertainties. This is affecting not only Radio segment, but the overall media industry.

items.statement: Radio inventory utilization down 8% but pricing improved ~4%; Gaana subscription price increased to INR 799 annual pack; cost rationalization via station networking and AI tools underway
items.quote: So inventory utilization has gone down by about 8%, but the price has improved by almost 4%.

items.statement: Revenue mix: Radio 56%, Digital 28%, Non-FCT/Events balance; Digital contribution up from 23% to 30.2% YoY; Gaana profitable subscriber mix ~70%
items.quote: So it's almost equal for us in terms of 56% Radio, 28% Digital and balance is non-FCT.

items.statement: Digital investment declined to INR 8.3 cr from INR 9.8 cr YoY; ongoing operational efficiency efforts using AI and broadcasting tools to reduce fixed cost base
items.quote: I'm happy to report that investment in Digital business declined to INR8.3 crores from INR9.8 crores in the same quarter last year, reflecting the results of our ongoing operational efforts.

items.statement: Some Events cancelled in Q1 due to artist travel disruptions from West Asia conflict; a few international concerts moved to Q2; Events business H2-heavy (35/65 split)
items.quote: There were a couple of international artist concerts we wanted to do, which are happening in quarter 2. But largely, sometimes it does happen that the events are planned for that month, and if that gets cancelled, then you lose the event.

items.statement: Geopolitical conflict (West Asia) causing event cancellations and artist travel disruptions; media fragmentation pressuring vanilla advertising across all traditional media; subscriber acquisition cost volatility in music streaming
items.quote: Performance was affected by the geopolitical conflict and related uncertainties, which led to our event cancellations, curtailed travel activities of artists and consequently lower business volumes during the quarter.

items.statement: Cash balance INR 390 cr as of June 30, 2026; buyback discussed at Board level but no decision announced; evaluating strategic initiatives
items.quote: The company continues to maintain a robust balance sheet with a cash balance of INR390 crores as of June 30, 2026.

items.statement: Three business verticals: Radio, Digital (Gaana), Events; experimenting with AI internally but sector focus remains media; no diversification plans outside media
items.quote: So Suresh, so far, we have concentrated on the Media business, but with new tech of AI and all, we do delve on that, and we keep experimenting on and do internal investments on usage of AI, but largely, our overall sector will remain media.

items.statement: Target Express Logistics EBITDA margin of 7.5% for FY27 and 10% over 3 years
items.quote: when we did this 3-year plan vision, which we shared with all of you, we had said it will be 7.5% on the Express margin so that we are looking at in this year. And if you see 10% is the target in that plan, so we are inching up towards that direction.

items.statement: Consolidated pre-Ind AS adjusted EBITDA margin target of 5-6% for FY27
items.quote: We are sticking to that plan. This year, the trajectory on this front is to be in the level of 5% to 6% and improve from there on.

items.statement: Aim to grow faster than logistics industry by a percentage point
items.quote: whatever logistics industry growth is, we will be at a percentage point above the logistics industry. That's the strive we have for growth.

items.statement: Express Logistics gross margin improved 100bps YoY to 26.3% in Q1 FY27
items.quote: If you see this quarter, both the yield effort and the volume growth has shored up the gross margin from the last year number of 25.3% to 26.3%. So there's a 1% improvement in the gross margin of Express business in this quarter.

items.statement: Express Logistics EBITDA margin at 6.2% in Q1 FY27, Consultative Logistics at 29.56%
items.quote: Express is at 6.2% and at CL, we are at Consultative Logistics, we are at 29.56%. So that's the breakup you're looking at, right?

items.statement: Express realization up 6.4% YoY; ~80% from service-driven escalation, ~20% from diesel pass-through
items.quote: the natural escalation is a larger pie, which would be, let's say, 80% and 20% would be around on the pass-through of diesel impact.

items.statement: Logistics industry expected to grow at low double-digits (1.2-1.5x GDP of 6-7%)
items.quote: the logistics industry by that factor will be anywhere in the low double-digit range. So that's what we estimate.

items.statement: Express KEA revenue share reclassified to ~60%, retail ~20%, balance strategic
items.quote: KEA that we account for here are at about 60% of our revenue, retail at about 20% and the balance is strategic.

items.statement: Consultative Logistics space reduced from 8.4M to 7.5M sq ft deliberately to cut white space cost
items.quote: 2 large warehouses we did action in terms of reducing the white space impact. So that was one deliberate attempt by us to reduce that white space as a cost.

items.statement: Other income INR14 crores includes INR8 crores lease closure gain, INR2 crores interest, INR4 crores liquidity/refunds
items.quote: One exceptional is the lease closure, which has happened in this quarter. So that's one INR8 crore amount, which is the other income component sitting here, plus we have received some income refunds and there's an interest component of INR2 crores.

items.statement: Express business 95% road, 5% air by volume
items.quote: About 95% of our business is road and about 5% is air.

items.statement: Expect to reach 1 MMT crude oil production every quarter from now onwards if conditions remain favorable
items.quote: If everything remains ceteris paribus, then given everything going good and nothing adverse happens in the field, we expect that we will be reaching 1 MMT every quarter from now onwards.

items.statement: Targeting 4.2 MMT crude oil production by FY29 from main producing areas and Rajasthan
items.quote: So we have we have some thoughts in mind to go to 4.2. If you if you look at our FY29 kind of target, we are targeting around up to around 4.2.

items.statement: Expect natural gas production of 3.8 BCM in FY28 with ramp-up to 5 BCM from first quarter of FY29
items.quote: Yes next year it will be 3.8 BCM. So now on an averaging we are shutting down some wells at least 30 wells we are always shutting down.

items.statement: Targeting 100 wells drilled in FY27 including 42 exploratory and 57 development wells
items.quote: Like last year we drilled 74 wells and this year we are targeting 100 which includes onshore as well as offshore.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 capex spent INR 3,050 crores; full year budget estimate INR 8,600 crores subject to revision
items.quote: The total amount spent is around INR3,050 crores, which for survey we can -- it is INR450, for exploratory drilling it is INR1,230 crores, development drilling we have spent INR700.

items.statement: NRL expansion capex INR 30,000 crores spent so far; total refinery project estimated at INR 34,000-35,000 crores plus PPU project INR 7,200-7,300 crores
items.quote: We have invested around INR30,000 crores so far. So we should be completing the refinery project around INR34,000 crores to INR35,000 crores and we should also be completing the PPU project by spending another INR7,200 crores or INR7,300 crores.

items.statement: DNPL pipeline 200-meter connectivity within NRL campus to be completed in 2-3 months; Paradip-Numaligarh pipeline mechanical completion by October, commissioning by December
items.quote: By December we will commission the pipeline, yes. October we are taking a target for mechanical completion.

items.statement: NRL Q1 FY27 GRM USD 35.95/bbl including ~USD 2/bbl inventory gain; normalized GRM ~USD 33/bbl vs typical USD 7-8/bbl
items.quote: See, I heard that question on the GRM. See I think the GRM reported was 35. That accounts for around 2 that we have gained in terms of inventory gain. So if you back that out, it will be 33 for GRM.

items.statement: NRL per barrel operating cost currently USD 4.5-5, expected to decline to USD 3.5 after expansion stabilization
items.quote: Our per barrel operating cost hovers around USD4.5 to USD5 today. It will come down to a level of USD3.5.

items.statement: BCPL gas offtake stable at 1.25-1.35 MMSCMD; NEEPCO reduces gas consumption when hydro power is cheaper
items.quote: BCPL offtake more or less it has picked up and it's currently stable.

items.statement: GST on royalty liability ~INR 2,500 crores principal (no interest) to be paid within 6 weeks per court order; already provided for in financials
items.quote: So without interest it would be roughly about INR2,500 crores. So our undertaking to the court was that the court has given us six weeks time to settle this and we are trying to kind of make this payment as quickly as possible.

items.statement: Assam land tax case withdrawn by state government; contingent liability to be removed from books once formally repealed
items.quote: So far whatever we have shown in our financials, we have shown them as contingent liability. So it has not impacted our financials at all. And in the days ahead as long as, I mean we'll have to wait till it is withdrawn by the state.

items.statement: NRL CDU/VDU, DHDT and SRU units to be commissioned by Oct-Nov 2026; remaining units by March 2027; 75% capacity utilization by Q4 FY28
items.quote: So these three units will be commissioned by say October or November at best and rest of the units we are still taking a target of commissioning by 31st March 2027.

items.statement: Deepwater exploration campaign: first rig arriving June-July 2027, second rig by March 2028; government reimbursement up to INR 675 crores/well for deep/ultra-deep wells
items.quote: The first rig is going to come in June-July 27 and the second rig is going to come by March 28. And that will kick start our deep water exploration campaign.

items.statement: Andaman Vijayapuram-1 well testing via hydro-frac in August 2026; Vijayapuram-4 well drilling by December 2026; 3D seismic interpretation by January 2027
items.quote: So this will take about a month in Vijayapuram 1 for the testing to be complete. And then we will demobilize this rig, our current rig, semi-submersible rig that we have, because it has completed its contractual tenure.

items.statement: Group total debt ~INR 37,233 crores: Oil India standalone USD 1.4B Mozambique loan, Singapore subsidiary USD 500M bond due May 2027, NRL INR 19,000+ crores
items.quote: Total debt in the group level, which is around INR37,233 crores is our total debt.

items.statement: Board approved preferential issue in HT Media and Digicontent to retire 30-50% of debt, improve EPS and credit rating; priced per SEBI formula at INR 24.7
items.quote: Once the preferential capital comes in, the money will be used to retire the debt. At least 30 % to 50% of the debt will be retired, which will definitely be accretive to the EPS and long-term interest coverage ratio, our credit rating and so on and so forth.

items.statement: Newsprint prices peaked at $650-700/metric ton, expected to plateau then decline; rupee at lifetime high adds cost pressure
items.quote: After that, it had come down very substantially. But after that, this is the highest peak that we have seen at about $650 to $700 a metric ton. We believe that the prices have peaked and should plateau at this level before they start coming down.

items.statement: Print EBITDA margin at 13% in Q1 FY27; management says use as baseline but margins depend on newsprint and FX
items.quote: So by and large, in your modelling, you can use that, but I told you what the imponderables are. So, let's say theoretically, if the dollar goes to 100 and the commodity goes to 700, then suddenly we'll have a margin dilution.

items.statement: Print ad revenue growth of 15% driven substantially by yield/pricing improvements; government ad rates increased in Nov 2025 after seven years
items.quote: So, a substantial part of that revenue growth of 15% is driven by our pricing . Of course, Government gave a price increase in November last year, but that was after seven years.

items.statement: Commercial print ad volumes held steady; government ad revenue grew on both volume and pricing
items.quote: We have seen commercial revenues holding from a volume perspective. We have had a benefit of yield improvement there. With respect to government revenues, we have a combination of both volume and pricing

items.statement: Digital revenue down 28% YoY as portfolio deliberately reset to leaner, profitable offerings; Digital EBITDA margin -12%
items.quote: Digital revenue moderated during the quarter as we deliberately reset the portfolio around leaner, more focused offerings with the intent of driving sustainable and profitable growth.

items.statement: No specific capex guidance given; cost discipline and right-sizing reduced consolidated employee cost from INR 111 cr to INR 99 cr YoY
items.quote: Well, we've been driving efficiency. I think that's something that we've been saying for the past sometime. We've been right-sizing the organization and that's basically what it is.

items.statement: Elevated newsprint prices, weaker rupee, and global supply chain uncertainties cited as concerns going forward
items.quote: However, elevated newsprint prices, a weaker rupee, and global supply chain uncertainties are causes for concern going forward.

items.statement: Radio revenue flat YoY; segment leaner after surrendering non-viable station licenses; Radio EBITDA negative INR 3 cr
items.quote: Radio revenue remained broadly steady year-on-year. The segment is now operating on a leaner and more sustainable footprint following the surrender of licenses for certain non-viable stations.

items.statement: No specific revenue or earnings guidance given; management hopeful of sustaining performance but cites imponderables
items.quote: We would not, as per usual practice, be giving any specific guidance on revenue or earnings projections.

items.statement: Management expects full-year operating EBITDA margin of around 8% for FY27, up from 7.3% in Q1, driven by better commodity cost pass-through in H2.
items.quote: initially, at the beginning of this year, we had guided that we should be probably close to 8% kind of a margin for the whole year, at least at the operating level, which is this quarter about 7.3%.

items.statement: Total capex for FY27 is about INR400 crores, focused on completing compressor and refrigerator projects and consolidating plastic moulding operations at the new Salarpur facility.
items.quote: This year, the total capex that we have is about INR400 crores, which is going to actually be utilized in completing the ongoing projects of compressor and refrigerator.

items.statement: No firm order book numbers shared; AC order book for next season will start building from September-October, while washing machine has some volume commitments from client partners.
items.quote: We do not share any order book numbers. And typically, the order book is not in terms of any firm commitment.

items.statement: Q1 consolidated EBITDA margin was 7.7%; gross margin percentage softened due to higher commodity prices and rupee depreciation, but per-unit margin remained stable year-on-year.
items.quote: EBITDA came in at INR156.2 crores versus INR139.4 crores last year with a growth of 12.1% and margin of 7.7%.

items.statement: Commodity cost increases (copper, aluminum, rupee depreciation) partially passed through via 10-12% ASP increase in RAC; further price hikes expected from December quarter as copper crosses $14,000 and rupee hovers at INR95.5-96.
items.quote: we are hopeful that we'll be able to again pass -- go for a price increase going forward because today, the copper has crossed $14,000 and the rupee is also hovering around INR95.5 and INR96.

items.statement: Industry RAC primary sales grew 20-25% in Q1 (10-15% volume + 10-12% value); secondary sales better than primary, channel inventory near normal levels at 4.5-5.5 million units.
items.quote: overall industry has done around 10% to 15% better, 15% better as compared to last year. And on the couple of that, if you combine that with around 10% to 12% value growth in the ASP, so the combined is around 20%, 25% is the growth in the -- at the primary level for the RAC.

items.statement: RAC volume grew 20-22% in Q1 with 10-12% ASP increase; washing machine grew 67% YoY, fully automatic up 150%; refrigerator commercial production targeted by Q4 FY27, compressor mass production by December-January.
items.quote: RAC at a volume level has grown around 20%, 22% for us in this quarter. And rest of the value has come from the price increases. ASP has increased by around 10% to 12%.

items.statement: Industry imports 50-60% of compressors; new import quota restricts imports to 25% of FY25 levels until March 2027, then zero; potential supply tightening from January-February 2027 if demand is strong.
items.quote: at the industry level, I think we are still importing around 60% of our compressor requirements in India right now, around 50% to 60% right now. And Government of India has already announced, a notification has come where any compressor import is allowed, but that is restricted to 25% of your FY '25 imports.

items.statement: Washing machine capacity now 3 million units annually with new DMIC plant; targeting 70-80% utilization by FY28. Refrigerator facility at Sri City (1.2M units) targeting commercial production by Q4 FY27. Compressor plant at Supa (2M units)
items.quote: this new capacity, which is coming online will bring our total capacity to around 3 million. And we are hopeful that in next 1 or -- maybe by -- not by end of this year, maybe by the FY '28, we should have almost around 70% to 80% utilization of our total capacity.

items.statement: Management aspires to surpass FY25 earnings in FY27; expects 20%+ volume growth for full year on low base and market share gains from compressor backward integration.
items.quote: We are hopeful that we -- coming to the earnings, we are very hopeful that we should be able to surpass the '25 numbers this year.

items.statement: Washing machine margins under pressure due to sharp resin price increases; full pass-through not achieved in Q1, expecting price increases in coming quarters to normalize margins.
items.quote: in washing machine, because of the fact that resin prices, plastic resin prices have risen very sharply the full pass on of the commodity prices has not happened in this quarter.

items.statement: Geopolitical and supply chain risks remain; compressor project dependent on overseas suppliers for critical components; demand uncertainty could impact new capacity utilization.
items.quote: There can be a lot of geopolitical factors right now. See, we are living in such uncertain times. You don't know what will happen tomorrow.

items.statement: AC contribution to sales currently 60-65%; target to reduce to 50-55% over next 2-3 years through washing machine, refrigerator, electronics and plastic business growth.
items.quote: Today, AC contributes almost 60% to 65% of the sales in the company, which we want to bring down closer to 50% to 55% over the next 2 to 3 years.

items.statement: Compressor plant first line (2M units) commissioning in 6 months; subsequent lines can be added in 3-4 months each; same facility can accommodate 4 lines total (8M units).
items.quote: first line has taken us -- is going -- is taking us close to about 6 months to commission. But the next line, we think we will be able to commission in a much shorter time, maybe 3 to 4 months.

items.statement: Fixed asset turnover target >4x on gross block; compressor business expected to be margin additive as it will be used largely for in-house AC production initially.
items.quote: Overall, on a company basis, we all the time target that fixed asset turn should be more than 4x.

items.statement: Full-year volume growth of 20%+ seen as base case; prepared for higher volumes if industry grows faster; expect to outperform industry growth by 4-5 percentage points.
items.quote: we think that we should be having close to 20% plus kind of a volume growth for the full year.

name: Multi Commodity Exchange of India Ltd

items.statement: Q1 FY27 total income grew 85% YoY to INR752 crores; revenue from operations grew 88% to INR702 crores; EBITDA more than doubled to INR544 crores at 72% margin; PAT at INR413 crores
items.quote: So, during the quarter, our total income increased by 85% to INR752 crores and revenue from operations grew to INR702 crores, which is an 88% growth. EBITDA more than doubled to INR544 crores, and there is a good EBITDA margin of 72% with a PAT at INR413 crores.

items.statement: Silver 100 Grams Futures contract launched successfully in response to market demand; already seeing good performance and providing accessible hedging and investment product
items.quote: We've had a whopper of a contract! We've had a very successful launch of the Silver 100 Grams Futures contract. This was a demand from the market given the price of silver. In a quick response to market demand , the product was launched and has already seen a very good performance

items.statement: MCX bullion price adopted by 50+ AMCs for AUM calculations following regulatory directive; Good Delivery Norms expanded to include silver and first domestic silver refiner empanelled; three domestic gold refiners also empanelled
items.quote: Towards the end of last quarter, we had a regulatory directive by which exchange discovered price was to be used by the AMCs for AUM calculations. We have worked very closely with the industry and have a number of AMCs, at least 50-plus AMCs, who are today using MCX bullion price as a reference for AUM calculations.

items.statement: MCX Coal Exchange of India incorporated after regulatory approval; procedural items underway to create transparent, efficient, technology-driven national coal trading ecosystem aligned with government reforms
items.quote: Another industry milestone is we are at a very early stage of work on our coal exchange. On approval from the regulator, we have incorporated the MCX Coal Exchange of India and other procedural items are in play towards the next steps on this.

items.statement: Expect continued strong growth momentum at fundamental level in FY27; Q4 FY26 was exceptional due to macro factors but controllable indicators remain strong
items.quote: So, we do see growth to be on a strong track this year. While the very strong macro factors may or may not necessarily kick in, that's not something that is in our control. But all the controllables have strong indicators, and we do expect the numbers to be strong.

items.statement: Expect higher traded UCCs in FY27 vs FY26 full year of 20 lakh; substantive headroom for growth remains; Q1 FY27 UCCs flat QoQ but positive trendline
items.quote: Last year, we closed at 20 lakh at a full year number. And we do expect to have higher numbers this year. And the headroom for growth continues to be substantive.

items.statement: Bullion Options Notional ADT rose 116% QoQ while Premium ADT fell 27%; premium-to-notional ratio dropped from 1.03% to 0.35% due to volatility normalization; volumes healthy with Gold options ADV ~300 metric tons (100% QoQ increase) and Sil
items.quote: So, we are looking at, for example, in gold, something like AD V - Average Daily Volume, in options of about 300 metric tons, which is a 100% increase over last quarter. Similarly, we are looking at in silver, about 9,400 metric tons, which is again approximately 2% or more increase over last quarter. So, volume-wise, it's healthy. There is that sort of price impact kicking in. Volatility is certa

items.statement: Technology capacity well positioned: handled >3 billion transactions/day vs <1 billion/day four quarters ago; capacity to handle >2x current peak; new Executive Director for Critical Operations and Technology focused on scale, resilience an
items.quote: In fact, just in the last one year, we have very successfully handled large volume of transactions. We would have started the year at less than a billion. And when I say a year, I'm talking of maybe four quarters back, a billion transactions a day, and we've already handled more than 3 billion transactions a day with the capacity to handle more than double that.

items.statement: Electricity futures Q1 ADT ~INR37 crores with ~55% market share; open interest ~1,630 lots (>70% market share) across 3 months indicating strong hedging utilization
items.quote: So, electricity futures Q1 ADT is about INR37 crores. We stand at, I think, about 55% or so from a market share standpoint when it comes to ADT. However, what we've done over the course of the year is really look at studying our market needs very carefully.

items.statement: Float income on margin money was INR30 crores in Q1 FY27

items.quote: Yeah, in terms of listing, if I am not wrong on the question, for the current quarter which is going on, we expect a minimum of 3 to 4 IPO listings should happen.

items.statement: Gretex Share Broking Limited progressing towards proposed listing
items.quote: Our subsidiary, Gretex Share Broking Limited, continues to progress towards its proposed listing, and its strong contribution this quarter reaffirmed the strategic value of scaling our broking and market-making operations.

items.statement: Domestic equity participation robust with growing investor base and financialization of savings
items.quote: At the same time, domestic participation in the equity market has remained robust, supported by a growing inves tor base and increasing financialization of savings

items.statement: Gradual shift towards professionally managed investment solutions across mutual funds, PMS and AIF platforms
items.quote: We are also seein g a gradual shift towards professionally managed investment solutions, with rising interest across mutual funds, PMS and alternative investment platforms

items.statement: Industry navigating headwinds from evolving geopolitical uncertainties
items.quote: While the industry continues to navigate headwinds arising from evolving geopolitical uncertainties, we remain confident in the long-term growth prospects of the Indian capital markets.

items.statement: US customers re-engaging after tariff uncertainty; Europe automotive components growing; domestic industrial bearing rings soft but automotive bearing rings strong
items.quote: The US market is coming back with the customers reengaging after a prolonged period of caution. Europe continues to fire on the back of our expanding automotive components presence there

items.statement: Management guides for 10-15% top-line growth across all segments for FY27
items.quote: We're looking at growth of, say, 10% to 15% on top line and it will be across all the segments.

items.statement: Hopeful to achieve double-digit volume growth for FY27 despite current war disruption
items.quote: We're still positive in long term. And we're hopeful that for the year, we can still close out on double-digit growth.

items.statement: Snowman Logistics adding ~24,000 pallets in FY27 with Pune and Patna facilities
items.quote: This year we'll see around 24,000 additional pallets, I mean, by end of this year.

items.statement: Snowman achieved 5-7% average pricing increase in warehousing; further hikes expected on renewals
items.quote: In terms of percentage, I cannot say right away, but in a range between 5% to 7% on an average is what we have got from most of the customers.

items.statement: Gateway passed on 35% Haryana minimum wage hike and fuel cost increases to customers with a time lag; impact more visible in Q2
items.quote: Haryana had an increase by 35% in minimum wages. We've tried to pass it on to customers, but there is a time lag in that also. Fuel also, most of it, we've been able to pass on. So that impact will be more visible in Q2.

items.statement: Double stacking dipped to 39% from 40-42% last year; import-export mix shift pressuring rail margins
items.quote: On double stack, basically, we're at 39%. So, it has dipped a bit from last year where we were at like 40% to 42% depending on the quarter.

items.statement: Ankleshwar ICD estimated to ramp to ~5,000 TEUs/month within 3-4 years; currently zero EXIM volume
items.quote: We also estimate that, say, within 3, 4 years, we should be doing a similar number.

items.statement: DFC JNPT connection complete but cargo shift will take months; Mundra/Pipavav congestion may drive some volume to JNPT
items.quote: Maybe it will take a couple of more months to see the cargo shifting towards JNPT. But now if we look at, after this West Asia crisis, wherein imports dried up in the months of April, May, there has been some improvement on the import side from June, July onwards.

items.statement: Cash tax rate to remain ~18.88% for 7-8 years due to large accumulated MAT credit
items.quote: We will be paying at the rate of 18.88% for at least 7, 8 years. So, we have a large amount of accumulated MAT credit, which we will be utilizing over the next 7, 8 years.

items.statement: CFS business not actively for sale after failed valuation attempt 1.5 years ago; open to deal if right valuation emerges
items.quote: We undertook an exercise, but we didn't get the right valuation. This was about 1.5 years ago. And since then, we've not been actively looking because we reached about a net debt-zero position earlier in the year when we paid out the special dividend.

items.statement: Net VNB margin improved 750 bps YoY to 22.9% in Q1 FY27
items.quote: The net VNB margin has improved by 750 basis points on a year-on-year basis from 15.4% for the quarter ended 30 June '25 to 22.9% for the first quarter of the current year.

items.statement: Management expects VNB margin to improve further from Q1 levels and settle around industry average
items.quote: In terms of VNB margin, we expect the margin to grow something more than where we currently are and settle something around the industry average.

items.statement: VNB margin target of mid-20s is on track for end of FY27
items.quote: Yes, sir. Yes, we are working towards that.

items.statement: Non-par share of individual APE rose to 32.49% in Q1 FY27 from 30.34% a year ago
items.quote: Our non-par share of individual APE has grown to 32.49% for the quarter ended 30th June '26 as compared to 30.34% in the same period for the previous year.

items.statement: Individual non-par savings grew 59.24% and protection grew 43.59% YoY in Q1 FY27
items.quote: The significant impact is of business mix where we have shown a significant growth in individual non-par savings, particularly to the extent of 59.24%. And the protection business, the growth is around 43.59%.

items.statement: Bancassurance start delayed in Q1 due to pending marketing plans with bank partners; expect catch-up in subsequent quarters
items.quote: In the first quarter, we did not -- we had not finalized a few marketing plans of some of our bank partners. So naturally, the starting was a bit delayed. We expect it to be covered up in the subsequent quarters.

items.statement: GST exemption on individual premiums removed input tax credit, increasing expense ratio by 16 bps YoY
items.quote: While the GST has gone on the individual lines and the premium, the nonavailability of input tax credit has had an impact on the overall expense ratio. And this comparison with the corresponding first quarter of last year when we had the ITC available is something which has resulted in a 16 basis points increase in the overall expense ratio.

items.statement: Solvency ratio at 2.42% pre-dividend; will drop to 2.32% post-dividend; future level depends on regulatory changes and protection growth
items.quote: If you take away the amount of dividend that was paid subsequent to this quarter, it will come down to 2.32%. We would like to see how the changes make the capital requirement fit as well as the growth in protection and other business and that also can be supported.

items.statement: Government sold 6.5% stake via OFS; public float now 10%, compliant with minimum public shareholding norms
items.quote: Recently, the Government of India has sold 6.5% stake in LIC via an offer-for-sale, which has been well received by the market. With this 6.5% OFS, our public float rises to 10%, and we are now compliant with the currently applicable minimum public shareholding norms.

items.statement: Minimum sum assured for major products increased from INR 1 lakh to INR 2 lakh in October 2024, driving higher average ticket size
items.quote: October '24, yes. The proportion of policies sold at higher sum have increased, yes.

items.statement: Launched MyLIC and Super Sales Saathi apps in April 2026 under DIVE initiative to enhance digital experience
items.quote: The launch of MyLIC and Super Sales Saathi mobile applications in April 2026 marked a significant milestone in LIC's digital transformation journey. Introduced under LIC's digital innovation and value enhancement initiative, DIVE, these applications are designed to enhance customer experience, improve operational efficiency and strengthen digital accessibility.

items.statement: Total APE grew 8.22% YoY to INR 13,692 crore in Q1 FY27
items.quote: The total APE has grown by 8.22% to 13,692 crore rupees on a year-on-year basis.

items.statement: No formal guidance given; expect margins to improve over next few quarters excluding RFR uncertainty
items.quote: We don't normally give a guidance, but we expect it to improve over the next few quarters as well, of course, keeping the one uncertain factor of the RFR.

items.statement: Targeting 15%+ top-line growth for FY27
items.quote: we are getting very good response from our organized retailers seeing good growth and maintaining 15% plus growth overall this year. That's what overall target is.

items.statement: Full-year EBITDA margin target of 13%-13.5% including PLI
items.quote: So, from full year lens, we're targeting close to between 13%-13.5% margin. That's the target we are taking.

items.statement: Advertising spend target at 2% of sales for FY27
items.quote: So, overall, our year target is close to 2%. That's the target we'll maintain this year and from overall planning perspective.

items.statement: THF retail to open ~10 stores in FY27, targeting 50-60% YoY growth for 3-4 years
items.quote: And from THF lens, they are doing, they will open close to 10 stores this year. And largely, what we see that this business can grow at 50-60% year-on-year for next 3-4 Years.

items.statement: Sweets to grow 12%-13% and gifting 17%-18% in H2 FY27
items.quote: the sweets should grow at about 12% to 13% kind of a growth over last year, this Quarter 2, Quarter 3 put together. And, the gifting would be even higher in this stuff. So, sum total gifting would be, would be pretty good in this stuff and say upwards of about 17%-18% growth.

items.statement: Nepal JV plant to start production in 8-9 months with INR15 Cr investment each
items.quote: Now, the plant construction is getting ready. So, both parties invest close to INR15 Crores each and by, I think in next 8 to 9 months, the plant will get started and we will get the local production from Nepal.

items.statement: ASRS warehouse of ~1 lakh sq ft in Bikaner adding 1.2-1.3 lakh cartons capacity
items.quote: largely, our new ASRS investment has n't gone live this month. So, we've close to 1 lakh square feet of construction in Bikaner, where there's a lot of supply chain business will be there going forward, where we'll keep close to additional 1.2, 1.3 lakh cartons extra to ease on supply chain.

items.statement: Direct retail reach expanded to 370,000+ outlets, adding 17,000 in Q1 FY27
items.quote: And as we end this quarter, we are at 3,70,000 outlets plus is our direct reach, adding 17,000 outlets in Quarter 1.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin at 13.5% vs 12.2% in Q4 FY26
items.quote: From EBITDA lens, this quarter, our EBITDA was close to 13.5% versus last quarter, our EBITDA was close to 12.2%. So there was good increase in EBITDA margin compared to last quarter.

items.statement: Q1 volume growth: Ethnic Snacks 11.4%, Western Snacks 21.3%, Sweets 4.4%, Papad declined
items.quote: Within this , the Ethnic Snacks have grown at 11.4%, Western Snacks at 21.3%, Sweets at 4.4%. Papad was a bit challenging for th is quarter

items.statement: Export decline due to US tariff uncertainty and 2-3x freight cost increase causing shipment deferrals
items.quote: Export is the only channel , where, for the first time, we have seen that almost flattish or a negative growth of 2.2%, which primarily is on account of the U.S. tariff disturbances, which is happening. And more importantly is the crude oil prices going up, which has taken up the freight 2 x to 3x kind of a stuff, so, which is what has deferred certain

items.statement: Revenue growth target is 2x market growth; FY27 OSAT+PCB revenue target INR450-500 cr
items.quote: So we don't want to commit on the top-line number, but whatever the market growth is there, because of the strategic initiatives of keeping the inventory, keeping the manufacturing flexible, and having a very committed people, we are quite confident of achieving the twice the market growth.

items.statement: FY27 capex plan: INR300 cr OSAT, INR300 cr PCB, INR250 cr EMS; Q1 FY27 spend INR180 cr
items.value: INR300 cr OSAT, INR300 cr PCB, INR250 cr EMS
items.quote: We said we will be funding for this capex for this year is about INR300 crores for OSAT, INR300 crores for PCB, and about INR250 crores for EMS business.

items.statement: Order book stands at INR8,900+ cr; Q1 additions exceeded deliveries
items.quote: In the first quarter, our team has added more into the order book than what we have opened up or what we have delivered. So, very strong order book of more than about INR8,900 crores is in the system.

items.statement: EBITDA margin 15.6% in Q1; profitability normalization expected in 2 quarters; near-term margin pressure from component cost inflation
items.quote: We expect this could take a couple of quarters for profitability to normalize and return to the levels as we had earlier committed to.

items.statement: Component prices up 30-35%, PCB prices up 3x; pass-through with quarterly lag; forex impact 3.3% on EBITDA
items.quote: Other components, as you rightly said, the prices is going up by 30% -35%, and PCB is the one which is -- it's a challenging today because even order booking has gone with an advance payment.

items.statement: Demand remains strong across domestic and global markets; no customer cutbacks seen
items.quote: If you see the growth what is happening in both in the domestic and also global, in spite of the inflation that is happening across the world, be it North America or in India or in Europe, if you see, the demand has not softened at this point of time and it's still growing strong.

items.statement: EMS grew 48% YoY (standalone 53%), smart metering declined 12%; overseas entities grew 327%
items.quote: As a stand-alone EMS business if you see, our growth is 53%, from INR480 crores of last year to this year of INR639 crores stand-alone EMS business. My overseas entities if you take, from INR24 crores last year to INR102 crores, which has grown at 327%.

items.statement: Working capital days: receivables 163 (12M rolling), inventory 105 days; metering receivables INR1,311 cr; targeting cash positive by FY27 end
items.quote: In terms of working capital, even though the number of days has moved from 190 days for the quarter standalone, and if you look at the 12-month rolling, it is about 163 days.

items.statement: Cumulative OSAT+PCB capex ~INR1,200 cr spent; INR250 cr in transit; INR170 cr OSAT subsidy received
items.value: INR1,200 cr spent, INR250 cr in transit
items.quote: Both put together is INR1,200 crores, maybe about INR700 crores in OSAT and INR500 crores in our PCB. Ramesh Kunhikannan: And we have in transit around INR250 crores of items which are yet to come

items.statement: OSAT and PCB commercial revenue from Q3 FY27; both projects on track
items.quote: Our commitments, as indicated by Executive Vice Chairman during last year, we are going to have a commercial revenue booking from this year, from third quarter and fourth quarter, and we are committed to that.

items.statement: Smart metering business model under review; exploring divestment/service separation to de-risk receivables; update by February
items.quote: We have plans of various business model of divesting this other portion of its service provider separately, and making sure that the receivables from that is not impacting directly into our balance sheet.

items.statement: Space tech: 3U satellite prototype ready mid-next year; titanium gas bottle manufacturing for ISRO/DRDO
items.quote: Our first 3U satellite is currently in the prototype development phase, and we expect it to be ready to launch in middle of next year, once the required regulatory testing is complete.

items.statement: Debt-to-equity ~0.3x; total debt ~INR800 cr; approved long-term loans for Semicon/Circuit not yet drawn
items.quote: The debt-to-equity ratio is good at about 0.3% at this point of time. The exact number I'm not able to tell, around INR800 crores total.

items.statement: Consolidated effective tax rate 35% due to amortization (3%), intercompany interest capitalization (5%), loss-making entities (4%)
items.quote: effective tax rate is around 23%, and at the consolidated level, it is at 35%. And the walk for this is like amortizations whatever we are doing for the intangibles, so that is around 3%.

items.statement: August Electronics acquisition 1-year complete; good EBITDA margins; growth accelerating; exporting to Honeywell, Otis, Eaton
items.quote: You all know that we acquired August Electronics in July of last year, and at this point of time, we have completed 1 year of a successful acquisition. As Mr. Vice Chairman said, this has given us a good inroads into the North American

items.statement: Maintain full-year FY27 revenue growth guidance of 75% YoY and consolidated EBITDA margin of 20-22%
items.quote: And we maintain that revenue guidance of 75% growth over the previous year and an EBITDA margin of 20% to 22% on a consol basis is what we maintain our guidance for the full year basis.

items.statement: Equipment supply share in third-party order book increased to ~59% as of July 2026
items.quote: As of July '26, the share of equipment supply in our order book stood at approximately 59% with the balance 41% being turnkey.

items.statement: Signed 1.5 GW MOU with INOX Clean Energy in June 2026; 500 MW firm orders signed, balance 1 GW to follow
items.quote: We are pleased to inform you that INOX Wind has signed an MOU for 1.5 gigawatt. I'll repeat again, 1.5 gigawatt with INOX Clean Energy in June, out of which firm orders have been signed for 500 megawatts so far.

items.statement: Received 200 MW LOA from NLC India in July 2026 via tender process
items.quote: In another positive development in the first quarter, we have received an LOA for 200 megawatt from NLC India. This is a repeat order from NLC in the month of July through an extensive tendering process.

items.statement: 4X wind turbine prototype installation on track for August 2026; commercial launch expected by end of FY26
items.quote: We are on track to install the first prototype in the month of August with commercial launch expected by end of FY26.

items.statement: INOX Green maintains 50% EBITDA margin guidance for wind O&M portfolio
items.quote: Generally, our guidance on the O&M business of Wind portfolio stands at 50% EBITDA margin. and that has been guidance.

items.statement: INOX Green maintains INR 600 crore annual EBITDA guidance for FY27 on consolidated basis post Wind World acquisition
items.quote: I think beyond whatever is there in the public domain or what we have guided for INR600 crores, we are sticking to that during the -- we are in the silent period.

items.statement: Expect 8-10 GW annual wind capacity additions in India over next few years driven by RTC, FDRE, hybrid tenders
items.quote: We expect to see strong annual wind capacity additions ranging between 8 to 10 gigawatt over the next few years, driven by RTC, FDRE and hybrid capacity additions.

items.statement: Only force majeure events (e.g., Middle East crisis) seen as risk to meeting 75% revenue guidance; equipment supply pivot reduces execution risk
items.quote: And I would say only force majeure, things which are beyond our control. I mean no one had an inkling about this Middle East crisis. So something like that. Otherwise, this pivot to move to equipment supply, honestly, we don't see a risk of not meeting our deliverables.

items.statement: Wind World India acquisition approved by NCLT Ahmedabad; formalities to complete in Q2 FY27, financial consolidation thereafter
items.quote: We have received the approval from honorable NCLT, Ahmedabad for the acquisition of Wind World India Limited. The acquisitions formalities are expected to be completed in Q2 FY27, post which the financial consolidation will take place.

items.statement: Demerger of power evacuation infrastructure from INOX Green to IRSL completed August 1, 2026; IRSL to be listed post regulatory approvals
items.quote: Further, the demerger of the power evacuation infrastructure business from INOX Green into INOX Renewable Solution has been completed as on August 1, 2026, being the record date. IRSL would now be automatically listed on the stock exchange post receipt of regulatory approvals.

items.statement: Targeting near 100% indigenization of wind turbine components by end of calendar year 2026 for both 3X and 4X models
items.quote: Before end of the calendar year, we would be -- we hope that we are almost 100% on wind turbines. And I'm talking not only for our 3X model, but even for the 4X model.

items.statement: FY27 revenue growth expected a few percentage points above FY26's 21% YoY growth
items.quote: FY27 will see a top line increase, which is a few percentage points better than that.

items.statement: FY27 EBITDA margin expected to remain comfortably above 20%
items.quote: We are going to deliver FY27 also very comfortably over the 20% plus margin.

items.statement: Q2 FY27 revenue expected in line with Q1 FY27
items.quote: Q2 looks very robust, and I think Q2 should be in line with Q1.

items.statement: Second half FY27 expected to be better than first half due to ag recovery
items.quote: Given that the ag industry recovery is going to happen in the second half, I think that's a fairly obvious and a fairly visible outcome.

items.statement: Capex requirement for organic business is 2.5%-3.5% of revenue
items.quote: Our capex requirements as a business are roughly about 2.5% to 3.5% of our total revenue.

items.statement: Warehouse sales at 56% in Q1 FY27 vs 50-52% in Q1 FY26, driving higher EBITDA margin
items.quote: In Q1 FY27, our warehousing sales was roughly at about 56%. And in Q1 FY26, I think it was roughly about 50% to 52%.

items.statement: Large ag at cyclical bottom in CY2026 with 15-16% decline, recovery expected CY2027/FY28
items.quote: In calendar year '26, it's expected to degrow by about 15%, 16%. So this is the trough and then the recovery will begin.

items.statement: Small ag recovery starting, meaningful volume recovery expected CY2027
items.quote: After 3 consecutive years of volume decline, we are beginning to see some recovery in unit volumes and the direction of growth is encouraging.

items.statement: Targets 20-25% revenue CAGR over next five years
items.quote: Our confidence is in the underlying growth opportunity remaining strong, and we continue to target a 20-25% revenue growth CAGR over the next five years.

items.statement: Guides FY27 revenue growth around 25% YoY with volume growth of 10-12%
items.quote: Our revenue growth will be around 25%. That's what is we expect.

items.statement: Guides FY27 EBITDA at INR 7-8 per SCM for next three quarters
items.quote: In FY27, in the next three quarters, we expect EBITDA to be in the line of INR 7-8 per SCM, operating EBITDA.

items.statement: Expects FY27 volume to reach 250 MMSCM, up from 224 MMSCM in FY26
items.quote: Last year, we clocked 224 MMSCM. We expect that it will be in the range of 250 MMSCM by this year end.

items.statement: Incurred INR 67 crore capex in Q1 FY27, cumulative capex ~INR 1,090 crore
items.quote: We have incurred CapEx of approximately INR 67 crore in three months quarter in FY27 this year, given FY27 this year, taking our cumulative CapEx to around INR 1,090 crore in that range.

items.statement: TNSTC committed 200+ buses for CNG conversion in Namakkal-Trichy, 80 already operational
items.quote: They are going to assure us more than 200 buses in near future.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin 19%, PAT margin 10.5%, driven by favorable pricing and sourcing
items.quote: EBITDA, excluding other income, increased sharply to INR 62 crore, reflecting a growth of 139% YoY, with EBITDA margin expanding to 19% of profit after tax, which stood at INR 34 crore, which is up 140% YoY, with PAT margin improving to 10.5%.

items.statement: CNG volumes grew 22% YoY, commercial CNG up 75% YoY; CNG now 67% of total volume
items.quote: This was primarily driven by CNG volume that grew around 22% YoY and strong momentum on CNG commercial volume, which grew 75% YoY. This all has contributed 67% of the total volume during the quarter.

items.statement: Utilized INR 337 crore (68%) of INR 496 crore IPO net proceeds as of 30 June 2026; balance for Namakkal-Trichy CGD network
items.quote: We have utilized almost INR 337 crores out of the total net proceeds of INR 496 crores as on 30th June, 2026. This nearly represents 68% utilization. The balance amount is primarily a mark for the development of City Gas Distribution Network at Namakkal and Trichy GA.

items.statement: Revised AUM growth guidance to 20% for FY27 from previous guidance
items.quote: We have revised our guidance to 20%. We feel that with the momentum that we have in the quarter 1 and looking at the festive season approaching us and the way the liquidity is available to us and the demand that is there at the ground, we definitely feel that 20% is a growth that we can easily achieve.

items.statement: NIM guidance for FY27 at 12.3%-12.5%, confident of achieving upper end
items.quote: Our NIM guidance is around 12.5% on the upper spectrum and lower spectrum 12.3%. So we definitely believe that NIM will expand both on the side of the yield also as more and more of good portfolio becomes a part of the larger pool and the yield on the portfolio improves and collection also from the NPA improves.

items.statement: ROA guidance for FY27 at 3.3% upper spectrum, ROE at 18% upper spectrum
items.quote: ROA, we have guided for around 3.3% on the upper spectrum, and ROE of around 18% on the upper spectrum.

items.statement: Credit cost guidance revised lower, currently at 2.6% vs guided 2.7%-3.5% range
items.quote: We have given the guidance of around 2.7% to 3.5%. We are already below the lower spectrum of around 2.7%. We are already at 2.6% for the first quarter. And definitely, going forward, it will be improving in the coming quarters, so we have revised the guidance in terms of our credit cost.

items.statement: Targeting single-digit cost of funds by end of FY27, currently at 10.13%
items.quote: We feel that in the financial year, we should be able to come into single digits in terms of our cost of fund and availability of fund is already there.

items.statement: Branch network expansion planned to 1,740-1,750 branches in FY27 from current 1,670
items.quote: So we will be in the range of 1,750 to 1,740 branches. We are right now around 1,670 branches.

items.statement: Cost of funds reduced 14 bps to 10.13% in Q1 FY27, incremental borrowing cost at 9.8%
items.quote: In the quarter, we have reduced our cost of fund from 10.27% to 10.13%, 14 basis point reduction has already happened in the Q1 itself. And this is before the benefit of the rating upgrade.

items.statement: NIM expanded 50 bps YoY to 12% in Q1 FY27, further expansion expected in Q2
items.quote: Already, if you look at from a NIM perspective, as compared to the last financial year, the NIMs have improved. Last financial year, if you look at quarter 4 or the full year, we are flat. But if you look at from a quarter 1 perspective, there is a 50 bps of expansion already has happened.

items.statement: JLG lending rate increased from 23.5% to 24.85% at end of Q1 FY27
items.quote: On the price hike, we had increased the rate at the end of the quarter, so we had increased the rate by around from 23.5% to 24.85%.

items.statement: AUM mix at 76% JLG, 24% non-JLG; targeting 70-30 by FY27 end, long-term 55-45
items.quote: We had guided for this year at 75-25. We are already at 76-24. So this year, we will be around 70-30. And coming year, definitely, we will look at strategically where we want to be. But in a long-term scenario, AUM basis 50-45 but balance sheet basis, 60-40 will be there.

items.statement: Gold loan co-lending scaling at INR 100 crores/month, targeting INR 1,200 crores disbursement and INR 500 crores portfolio
items.quote: Our aim is to have around INR1,200 crores of disbursement and around INR500 crores of gold portfolio. We are likely to overachieve this number for sure.

items.statement: Assam flood exposure limited to lower Assam, natural calamity insurance covers all customers
items.quote: In Assam, the flood or this kind of a water problem is kind of an annual phenomenon, so one is that this is in upper Assam, we have no exposure to that state. We are at lower Assam, so our portfolio is not affected as of now entirely. And second aspect is we take natural calamity insurance for all our customers, so tha

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA breakeven expected in Q2 or Q3 FY27; Tritium EBITDA breakeven by Q4 FY27
items.quote: on a consolidated basis, the breakeven may be over the next 2 quarters itself. I can't specify whether quarter 2 or 3. But on a consolidated basis, it will be breakeven in quarter 2 and on Tritium level by quarter 4, '27.

items.statement: Tritium targets 3x revenue growth vs last year and EBITDA breakeven by Q4 FY27
items.quote: I'm sure that we will have 3x revenue growth compared to last year as well as EBITDA breakeven in quarter 4, '27.

items.statement: Consolidated order book at INR1,400+ crores as of 30 June 2026, a record high
items.quote: a consolidated book order of INR1,400 crores plus as on 30 of June, a record high sales and Tritium also looking up in terms of increased booking.

items.statement: EV charger order book near INR200 crores in India plus USD2 million exports; 180 DC chargers booked until Oct 2026
items.quote: today, we have an order book of almost INR200 crores for our AC/DC chargers in India, including exports of about USD2 million.

items.statement: Tritium bookings doubled to ~USD21 million in Q1 FY27 vs ~USD10 million prior quarters; revenue ~USD10.5 million
items.quote: the bookings are close to USD21 million this quarter, and you can see this is twice as big as the quarters before and the sales is roughly USD10.5 million.

items.statement: Standalone gross margin 29.1% in Q1 FY27, up 2% QoQ on better pricing and mix; down 3.6% YoY due to US input cost pressure
items.quote: Stand-alone gross margins for Q1 stood at 29.1%, which is 2% above the previous quarter, which is Q4 of last year on better pricing and customer mix in both the segments. On a year-on-year basis, gross margin was down by about 3.6%, primarily on account of the U.S.-led input cost pressure

items.statement: Large DC power system order margins offset by forex and commodity price rises; large volumes helped absorb some cost increases
items.quote: Some of these large orders, the margins were offset by a rise in forex and commodity prices. But due to large volumes, we were able to offset some of these cost increases.

items.statement: Supply chain disruptions in semiconductors, plastics, copper due to geopolitics impacting material availability and capacity utilization
items.quote: Some of the challenges today is not capacity, it's supply chain disruption. The geopolitical situation has caused supply chain disruption in semiconductors, anything plastic related, anything copper related has become very expensive.

items.statement: Tritium US factory capacity can service ~USD100 million revenue (2.5x current USD10 million quarterly run rate)
items.quote: I think the capacity there can service 2.5x of this revenue. So roughly, let's say, USD100 million, slightly more maybe. And we are doing 1/4 of that today.

items.statement: Revenue growth guidance of low to mid-teens for FY27
items.quote: I would like to reiterate my confidence in Emcure to deliver low to mid -teen revenue growth in FY27.

items.statement: EBITDA margin expansion guidance of 70 to 100 basis points for FY27

items.statement: Gross margin expected around 59% for FY27 due to international mix

items.statement: R&D expense expected between 4% to 5% of revenue for FY27

items.statement: Net debt expected to increase by INR 450-500 crore next quarter for Mantra and Gennova payouts
