items.statement: Net debt expected to reach INR 1,450 crore by end of next quarter
items.quote: by the end of next quarter, we should have a net debt of close to around INR 1,450 crore.

items.statement: Expect to become net cash by end of FY28
items.quote: Probably by the end of FY28, we should be net cash.

items.statement: Domestic business expected to grow in line with industry in Q2 and faster in second half
items.quote: From second quarter onwards, you'll start seeing us more in line with the industry and then second half will be faster than the industry growth.

items.statement: ARV contribution in ROW expected at 50%-55% for full year FY27
items.quote: for the full year, we do expect we end up at about that 50%- 55% range.

items.statement: Order book for liposomal amphotericin B across European countries expected to ramp up with supplies
items.quote: the order book across the different countries should also go up in line with the supplies.

items.statement: Domestic price growth around 4% to 5% in Q1 FY27
items.quote: I think price is about 5% for us, 4% to 5%.

items.statement: Significant global uncertainty from West Asia, Middle East, Russia-Ukraine but company showing resilience
items.quote: If you look at the global environment, what's happening in West Asia, Middle East or even for that matter, what's happening with Russia a nd Ukraine, there continues to be significant uncertainty, Emcureans have shown a lot of

items.statement: Acquired 12.05% minority stake in Gennova making it 100% owned subsidiary
items.quote: we have just recently acquired 12.05% minority stake in Gennova, making it a 100% owned subsidiary of Emcure.

items.statement: ICMR licensed novel anti-HPV candidate for cervical intraepithelial neoplasia to Emcure in July
items.quote: part of government technology transfer initiative, ICMR licensed a novel anti -HPV candidate for Cervical Intraepithelial Neoplasia to Emcure

items.statement: Signed royalty-free voluntary licensing agreement with Merck for generic alimatravir across 129 countries
items.quote: we signed a royalty-free, non-exclusive voluntary licensing agreement with Merck Sharp & Dohme to make and sell a generic version of experimental once a monthly oral HIV pill across 129 low and lower -middle income countries.

items.statement: International constant currency growth around 12% to 13% in Q1 FY27
items.quote: international would have been about 12% to 13%.

items.statement: Revenue growth guidance of 15% to 20% over a three-to-five-year period and EBITDA range of 28% to 30%
items.quote: We remain confident in our ability to sustain our longer-term revenue growth guidance of 15% to 20%, and the EBITDA range of 28% to 30%.

items.statement: FY27 capex guidance of INR1,100 crores to INR1,300 crores
items.quote: So, we have given a FY27 capex guidance of INR1,100 crores to INR1,300 crores. That still stands.

items.statement: Peptide manufacturing facility at new greenfield site near Hyderabad expected to be operational in 2028
items.quote: In addition, we plan to break ground for a peptide manufacturing facility at our new greenfield site near Hyderabad, which is expected to be operational in 2028.

items.statement: Formulation capabilities for oral solids up to Phase 2 expected to be operationally ready within six months
items.quote: While we are still about six months away from being operationally ready, we are seeing significant interest from our pharma partners.

items.statement: 33 active commercial molecules and 14 molecules in late phase in CMC business
items.quote: The underlying health of the CMC business continues to be strong with 33 active commercial molecules and 14 molecules in late phase.

items.statement: Six late phase molecules added over last 15 months, five through large pharma FTE engagements
items.quote: Over the last 15 -months, we have added six late phase molecules to our pipeline, 5 of which have come through large pharma clients with whom we have ongoing FTE engagements.

items.statement: Three of four new commercial contracts this year will be commercial supplies, two as primary supplier
items.quote: Three of the four that we will be working on this year, as we had mentioned during the last call, will be commercial supplies. Primary - Secondary, as we've discussed before right, they are, I think we probably are primary in two out of th is three

items.statement: Stronger H2 FY27 expected with planned capacity expansion going live in second half
items.quote: As we have discussed in the previous earnings call, we expect a stronger H2 with planned capacity expansion going live in the second half of the year.

items.statement: Geopolitical uncertainty and IP concerns strengthening India's role in customer diversification strategies
items.quote: From a customer s' standpoint, geopolitical uncertainty and concerns around intellectual property have made India an increasingly important part of their diversification strategies. I would say this trend has not only continued but strengthened.

items.statement: Building multi-modality capabilities across peptides, XDCs, and formulation; peptide development lab coming online shortly for top-tier pharma
items.quote: Peptides are an important modality for us. We have one of the largest and fastest -growing peptide team within discovery. While GLP -1s receive d significant attention, there is substantial work underway in macrocyclic peptides, peptide-drug conjugates, and radiochemistry applications.

items.statement: XDC Center of Excellence close to opening supporting payloads, linkers, conjugation across antibodies, peptides, PROTACs, oligonucleotides
items.quote: We are close to opening our XDC Center of Excellence , which will support both discovery and development teams in the synthesis of payloads, linkers, and conjugation across antibodies, peptides, PROTACs, and oligonucleotides

items.statement: Business has inherent lumpiness; quarterly revenue depends on shipment timing and purchase orders
items.quote: Given the inherent lumpiness in the industry and the way the business operates, we believe it is more appropriate to look at the direction of the business over a three-to-five-year period.

items.statement: Returning customers accounted for over 90% of revenue in FY25 and FY26
items.quote: We continue to add new customers, but returning customers accounted for over 90% of our revenue in FY25 and FY26.

items.statement: Contributed to five FDA-approved molecules in calendar 2025; supported 17 launches over past five years
items.quote: In calendar 2025, Sai contributed to five FDA-approved molecules, meaning we were part of either discovery or development or commercial manufacturing for the product. Over the past five years, we have supported 17 launches, demonstrating our ability to supply launch quantities and play a meaningful role in commercialization.

items.statement: Maintain EBITDA margin guidance of around 11% plus for FY27
items.quote: Accordingly, we remain committed to deliver healthy and sustainable profitability and maintain our EBITDA guidance of around 11% plus.

items.statement: Maintain revenue growth guidance of 20% year-on-year for FY27
items.quote: Of course. We maintain our guidance of 20% revenue growth for this year.

items.statement: Order intake guidance remains INR10,000+ crores of new orders for FY27
items.quote: And our overall order intake guidance remains the same. We will look at INR10,000 plus crores of new orders this year.

items.statement: Unexecuted order book of INR16,035 crores as of June 30, 2026, including L1 orders of INR400 crores
items.quote: As of June 30th, 2026, our unexecuted order book was INR16,035 crores, including L1 orders of INR400 crores.

items.statement: Quoted tenders worth more than INR20,000 crores to be declared in Q2 and Q3 FY27
items.quote: It is also noteworthy to note that we have quoted tenders worth more than INR20,000 crores, which will be declared in the coming quarter, that is Q2 and maybe part of Q3.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin at 11.7%, above the 11% guidance
items.quote: During the quarter, our revenue from operations grew by 5% year -on-year to INR1,736 crores, while EBITDA stood at INR203 crores, resulting in a healthy EBITDA margin of 11.7%, which is more than the guidance of 11% given at the start of the year.

items.statement: Conductor brownfield expansion phase 1 ready, awaiting approvals, expected to start in Q2 FY27
items.quote: So, what we have done is that the factory phase 1 is ready and we have calibrated all the equipment. There are certain approvals required from the various approving authorities , and we are confident in Q2, we will start this.

items.statement: Greenfield tower factory at Butibori, Nagpur commenced commercial production on April 24, 2026
items.quote: Greenfield has already started the tower factory in Butibori, Nagpur, as I read out in my opening statement, has already started on April 24.

items.statement: INR200 crores capex plan for tools and plants, 70% to be utilized in FY27, balance in FY28
items.quote: So, this INR200 crores is predominantly for tools and plants to execute our projects, both in domestic and international, and it is going to be used in a staggered manner quarter -on-quarter. So, I would say 70-odd percent would be utilized this year and the balance will go to next year.

items.statement: Board approved proposal to raise up to INR600 crores through QIP or other eligible securities, subject to approvals
items.quote: Further, subsequent to the quarter, Board has approved a proposal to raise up to INR600 crores through a qualified institutional placement, QIP, or other eligible securities, subject to the necessary shareholders and regulatory approvals.

items.statement: Global electricity demand expected to nearly double by 2050; India plans 191,000 circuit km transmission addition by 2032
items.quote: Global electricity demand is expected nearly double by 2050, driven by electrification, renewable energy adoption, AI, data centers, and rising energy consumption. In India, the National Electricity Plan envisages the addition of 1,91,000 circuit kilometers of transmission line by 2032.

items.statement: Evaluating strategic opportunities in BESS EPC, data center EPC, and drone mapping/survey; seed marketing underway
items.quote: BESS and data centers, we are keen to go ahead. If you see our investor presentation, it is already mentioned that it is something we are looking at in terms of seed marketing in the next few months.

items.statement: Bangladesh order book nearly complete, only INR300 crores remaining to be executed in next 3 months
items.quote: So, our Bangladesh book is almost complete. Out of INR4,500 crores, only INR300 crores is left, which we will complete in the next 3 months.

items.statement: Net debt increased due to delayed collections and higher working capital deployment, expected to normalize in Q2 FY27
items.quote: So, actually, net debt has increased on account of some delayed collections and working capital has been deployed more in the business, which is going to be normalized in Q2, and we are expecting all those to be realized in Q2.

items.statement: Revenue target of INR3,500-4,000 crores by FY30 reiterated
items.quote: Our objective remains unchanged: to build a stronger and more diversified and more profitable business while creating value for all stakeholders. We remain confident in our long-term growth roadmap and our aspiration of achieving revenue of INR3,500 crores to INR4,000 crores by FY'30.

items.statement: FY27 revenue growth expected up to 10% YoY if situation stabilizes
items.quote: We believe that in terms of top line, we will do quite well and we will be back on track and we will be able to deliver a growth year-on-year in the range of maybe up to 10%.

items.statement: Full-year FY27 EBITDA margin improvement of ~50 bps targeted if price recovery succeeds
items.quote: If we do that, we will be able to for sure increase our overall EBITDA versus last year, probably by half a point, I would say it's something realistic but we will try for sure to do more than that.

items.statement: Domestic agriculture revenue grew 32% YoY in Q1 FY27; construction domestic grew 20% YoY
items.quote: In agri business there is 32% growth, Q1 versus Q1. On the construction business domestic, there is a 20% growth.

items.statement: Export volumes expected to normalize from Q2 FY27 after one-off logistics disruption in Q1
items.quote: Probably already from Q2, you will see that in terms of volumes we will be more or less back on track. This is kind of a one-off dip for this quarter.

items.statement: New paint shop construction started; portal axle and sub-assembly capacity commissioned; capacity expansion aligned to INR3,500-4,000 crore FY30 target
items.quote: Construction of our new paint shop facility commenced during the quarter, while additional investments in portal axle capacity and sub-assembly operations were successfully commissioned. These initiatives are aligned with long-term growth plans.

items.statement: Order book encouraging; capacity debottlenecking and expansion underway to meet demand
items.quote: We are seeing order book which is quite encouraging for us. So, for the capacity to meet the market demand, we are doing the debottlenecking and expansion of wherever we need capacities to meet the market demand in the direction towards INR3,500 crores to INR4,000 crores.

items.statement: Engineering services assignments worth INR33 million completed in July 2026; discussions with another customer progressing
items.quote: Assignments worth approximately INR33 million that were under execution at quarter-end were completed in July 2026. Discussions with another prospective customer are also progressing, supporting further growth in this business.

items.statement: Export revenue split Q1 FY27: construction INR871M, agriculture INR424M, other INR357M
items.quote: Construction equipment in Q1 FY'27 was INR871 million and agriculture was INR424 million, and our other category was INR357 million.

items.statement: India EBITDA margin expected to increase 4-5% from solar project commissioning in Q1 FY28
items.quote: with our capex of about INR60 crores with a 3-year payback, I think that itself will increase the margin to maybe translate into 4% to 5% increase in my view.

items.statement: INR60 crore invested in captive solar plant with battery storage for Pune hotels targeting Q4 FY27 commissioning
items.quote: We have now invested around INR60 crores in captive solar plant with battery storage for our Pune hotels targeting commissioning in Q4 FY27.

items.statement: India EBITDA margin expanded to 36% from 35% YoY in Q1 FY27 despite higher power and wage costs
items.quote: India EBITDA grew 16% to INR74 crores. And most importantly, our India margin expanded 36% from 35% even after absorbing higher power and wage costs during this quarter.

items.statement: Maldives July tourist arrivals recovered to 2025 levels with only 27 disrupted flights vs 170 previously
items.quote: July tourist arrivals have actually recovered to 2025 levels. And this is with only 27 disrupted flights.

items.statement: Sahyadri Hills Ritz-Carlton Reserve acquired for INR281 crore equity, targeting >12% yield-on-cost with 80 keys and 33 branded residences
items.quote: We have acquired it 100% at an equity consideration of around INR281 crores and enterprise value of around INR466 crores, targeting a yield-on-cost above 12%.

items.statement: Maldives EBITDA declined 32% YoY due to diesel prices reaching 2.1x pre-war levels, adding INR19 crore fuel cost
items.quote: Diesel prices reached roughly 2.1x pre-war levels, driving a fuel and ancillary costs increase of around INR19 crores.

items.statement: Maldives solar program to save $1.5 million annually (~2.5% of EBITDA) from FY28, Raaya at 80% solar by April 2027
items.quote: Together, we expect this to save us around $1.5 million a year, roughly 2.5 percentage of Maldives EBITDA and to protect the portfolio against exactly this kind of diesel shocks in the future.

items.statement: Goa Hilton brownfield expansion of 50+ keys plus refurbishment and Sol De Goa and Saipem Hills projects targeting FY29-FY30 delivery
items.quote: All set to be delivered with refurbishment and rebranding in FY29, somewhere around FY29-FY30.

items.statement: Annuity business revenue grew 3% to INR128 crore with EBITDA flat at INR111 crore and 87% margin, 98% committed occupancy
items.quote: Revenue grew 3% to INR128 crores, with EBITDA broadly flat at INR111 crores at 87% margin and committed occupancy holding at 98%.

items.statement: Pune controls 65% of luxury inventory with no new supply announced for 4-5 years, providing structural pricing power
items.quote: we literally control 65% of the luxury inventory in Pune. And the important point here is not only that we control the inventory in Pune, the most important point i s that, there is no new supply announced in Pune, and we have a very clear runway at least 4 to 5 years

items.statement: India Q1 FY27 occupancy rose 7% to 67% with ADR up 8%, driving 20% RevPAR growth across Pune, Bengaluru, Goa
items.quote: Our occupancy grew to 67%, up about 7% is reflecting very, very strong demand both in Pune, Bengaluru, and Goa. Most importantly, the important point is we added occupancy and rate at the same time. I think that's something that's very unique. ADR also up about 8%, so that only happens when the demand is genuinely strong and the discounting is not really happening to fill

items.statement: Maldives Q3 and Q4 peak seasons expected to offset Q1 INR15 crore EBITDA impact from diesel spike
items.quote: The INR15 crores impact will be negated in Q3 and Q4.

items.statement: Sri Lanka Ritz-Carlton Reserve delayed to ~FY30 due to environmental permissions near Yala National Park and 1.5 km shoreline
items.quote: Once they are done, I think the targeted timeline is around FY30.

items.statement: Transitioned from old to new tax regime reducing rate from 34.94% to 25.17%, generating INR102 crore deferred tax reversal
items.quote: During the quarter, based on the assessment of expected future profitability and current tax liability, we have elected to transition from the old tax regime to the new tax regime. As a result, the applicable tax rate has reduced from 34.94% to 25.17%.

items.statement: EBITDA margin expected to normalize to 25-30% range in Q2-Q3 FY27 as raw material prices stabilize and price hikes flow through
items.quote: we expect EBITDA margins to gradually recover, and we are working towards stabilizing them in the 25% to 30% range during Q2 and Q3 of FY27.

items.statement: Industrial & fine chemicals vertical at Apiqo fully booked, expected to contribute Rs 120-150 crore of FY27 revenue
items.quote: Somewhere around 150 CR. Between 120 to 150.

items.statement: Anlon Biologics (peptides/biosimilars) construction to start within 2 months, revenue expected FY28 Q4; Anlon Medicare (surgical implants) revenue expected FY28 Q2
items.quote: by FY28 Q4 we'll start to generate the revenue and in Anlon Medicare at least by Q2 of FY28 we will start to generate the revenue.

items.statement: Plan to make Apiqo and Bizotic 100% subsidiaries via share swap by end of Q2 FY27
items.quote: we have already started to do the 100 making its 100% wholly own subsidiary by the way of share swapping. So that process is already going on. So, I think by end of the Q2 we'll complete it.

items.statement: FY27 revenue guidance maintained at Rs 3,200-3,400 crore; management confident of achieving target
items.quote: I strongly believe that we are on the right track to achieve the revenue guidance we have given in a range of Rs. 3,200 to 3,400 crore. I believe that we are absolutely on track and there are no concerns with respect to the business outlook as well as the execution capabilities.

items.statement: Executable order book stands at Rs 10,803 crore (Energy Rs 8,453 crore, Telecom Rs 2,350 crore) as of June 30, 2026
items.quote: As of 30th June, we have executable order book of Rs. 8,453 crore in energy and Rs. 2,350 crore in telecom ICT. Combined, our total executable order book at Rs. 10,803 crore.

items.statement: Energy:Telecom revenue mix expected to shift to 65:35 or 70:30 by FY27 end from current 80:20
items.quote: We estimate that this ratio should be between somewhere in the range of 65 :35 or 70: 30 when we close the financial year between energy and telecom.

items.statement: PAT margin guidance 10.5-11% for FY27; EPC margin 12-15%, BOO SPV IRR 12-13%, C&I BESS EBITDA margin 4-5% higher than grid-scale (13-15%)
items.quote: PAT margins we are trying to have about 10.5% to 11% for the mix of products and the projects.

items.statement: Strong BESS demand outlook; bidding for ~27 GWh tenders; NTPC Renewable Energy floated large tenders; C&I segment showing traction with thousands of units potential annually
items.quote: We also have the strong order pipeline and we are bidding for almost 27 GWh of tenders. Recently one or two customers, –such as NTPC Renewable Energy have floated big tenders, so we are hoping to get some good business out of that as well.

items.statement: BESS capacity expansion from 5 to 10 GWh by December 2026; third line (5 GWh) equipment arriving September 2026, installation Oct-Nov 2026
items.quote: Hopefully, by beginning of December, we would have 10 GWh operational facility, which would be the biggest operational plant in India by that time.

items.statement: Container manufacturing facility trial runs ongoing; batch production from next month; supplied 300+ containers; Q2 target 210 containers; 10 GWh = ~1,800 containers/year at 90% efficiency
items.quote: Basically, with 10 GWh our total production capacity will be 2,000 containers per year at a full efficiency. However, we always have to take some efficiency factor in terms of machine downtime and such other factors. Even if I take 90% efficiency, it will be about 1,800 containers in a year.

items.statement: Competitive intensity correcting: Maharashtra 4 GWh project cancelled, Punjab tender at better prices, NTPC tenders seeing 7-8 bidders vs 32-51 previously; only serious players remain
items.quote: There is a bit of correction in the bidding side. In the last six months till March, many people had bid aggressively. Though they are not from the energy sector or do not have background in this area.

items.statement: R&D center in Pune inaugurated 3 weeks ago led by Prof. Ogale with 8 PhD scientists; planning indigenous cell manufacturing in ~2 years; applied for 4 GWh PLI scheme (7-year duration)
items.quote: We have started a research center in Pune. It was inaugurated about three weeks ago and is led by Professor Ogale, who is also our Independent Director. A team of about eight experienced PhD holders scientists have joined the center.

items.statement: MEGMEET partnership for AI data center power solutions (Nvidia-approved) coupled with BESS; demo equipment preparation underway; concrete revenue plan expected next quarter
items.quote: We have tied up with them for providing those power solutions, coupled with our battery storage for all the new-age AI data centers in India. We already have started the work on the ground and there is a good amount of traction coming from the potential customers for these kinds of products.

items.statement: Saudi Arabia MOU signed; small container order executed in Q1; expecting export revenue ramp-up in subsequent quarters
items.quote: We have signed a MOU with a company in Saudi Arabia and we are also trying to explore the market in Saudi Arabia for the battery storage systems. We are actively exploring this opportunity and we expect this year we should have some portion of the revenue coming from the exports.

items.statement: Capex funded internally from private placement proceeds; seeking investors for BOO portfolio-level funding to accelerate developer projects
items.quote: Funded internally from our private say initial fundraising that we have done in terms of the private placement. We have funded using that amount.

items.statement: Operating cash flow negative due to telecom receivables (150 days NWC) vs energy (90-100 days); expect positive operating cash flow by March 2027 as energy contribution grows and telecom receivables ease
items.quote: By end of this financial year, we can expect that the cash flow from operation to significantly improve compared to the last financial year.

items.statement: Capex guidance for FY27 is INR350-450 crores, indicative and not precise guidance
items.quote: we are targeting to spend approx INR350 crores to INR450 crores for FY '27, which will support our double-digit top-line growth. Having said that, please be mindful that we are closely monitoring the economic environment across our key markets, and may pull in or pull-out capex based on the actual demand requirement. Please those please note these numbers are kind of indicative and are not really

items.statement: Capex includes INR140 crores for two announced plants and covers both Clean Air and ART segments
items.quote: this capex will be towards both the business segments, Clean Air and Powertrain as well as ART. And just to clarify, this includes the investment towards the two plants that we've already announced, which is amounting to about INR140

items.statement: EBITDA margin 17.9% on VAR in Q1 FY27, down from prior year due to public company costs and non-indexed commodity inflation
items.quote: EBITDA margins stood at 17.9% of VAR. While margins were impacted by significant commodity inflation, rupee depreciation, geopolitical supply chain disruptions, and incremental costs associated with operating as a listed public company, we were able to sustain strong profitability through disciplined execution, productivity initiatives, rigorous cost management, and commercial actions.

items.statement: Partial recovery of non-indexed commodity costs (rubber, plastics, crude, LPG, CNG) achieved; steel is back-to-back indexed
items.quote: what we're showing, this quarter's, performance, margin performance, indicates a partial recovery of that. I must congratulate our purchasing team to have tried very hard to recover this, but having said that, it is a very difficult challenge to recover some of these from our customers.

items.statement: Demand outlook good through Q2 FY27; Indian OEMs predicting strong demand unless Middle East war deteriorates
items.quote: even this quarter, even next quarter, at least the good news is where other regions in the world are struggling, India is still Indian OEMs are still predicting very good demand. Now, if the Middle East war continues on and on, there will be some impact, I think. I don't think it'll—the demand will keep continuing, but right now, it looks like through Q2 at least, the demand seems to be good.

items.statement: DCx32 launched targeting A/B segment vehicles; DaVinci platform winning multiple programs across existing and 4 new customers
items.quote: we introduced DCx32, the latest addition to the DCx family, specifically targeting smaller A and B segment vehicles and significantly expanding our addressable market opportunity. We also successfully completed fitment and performance benchmarking of our mechanical adaptive ride damping or MARD technology with a leading domestic OEM.

items.statement: Order book not disclosed quarterly; will report H1 order book at end of Q2 FY27; export order book 14-20% of total
items.quote: we decided that we would report order book every half-year, right? General Business - Tenneco Confidential So, H1 at the end of the second quarter, we'll report order book, and then again at the end of the full year we'll report second order book. So , if you can just be patient for a few more months, you'll have the H1 numbers as well

items.statement: Trump administration Section 232 tariffs on exhaust parts and macroeconomic conditions in Europe/Americas pose export challenges
items.quote: Yes, tariffs is a problem. The Trump administration levied additional tariffs on Section 232, which is the some of the exhaust parts that get exported from here. That affects other suppliers as well. So, it is a little bit of a downer, which makes the environment a bit tough for exports.

items.statement: Capacity utilization: CAPT >80%, ART >90%; new ART plant announced in western India with ~INR70 crores investment
items.quote: for CAPT, it is upward of 80%. However, Advanced Ride Technologies, we are really working more than 90% of the capacity currently. And that's one of the reasons we've already announced one new plant for Advanced Ride Technologies, that should be in the western part of the country, with an investment of INR70 crores approximately.

items.statement: Royalty at 2.5% of revenue (less intercompany sales), consistent with prior year
items.quote: royalty is 2.5% of the overall revenue, reduced by intercompany sales. So, that stays consistent, in line with the previous year. That's royalty.

items.statement: Cash generation 50-60% of EBITDA; capex fully funded from internal accruals; debt-free; evaluating M&A options
items.quote: we do generate a lot of cash, 50% to 60% of our EBITDA converts to cash. Our traditional business lines are big cash cows for us. So, we will use that for funding our capex, that INR350 crores to INR450 crores is fully generated, the capex is fully generated through internal accruals, so we're not even after spending that kind of cash, we're still debt-free.

items.statement: Segment II full-year FY27 operating margin visibility over 6.5%; aspiration 7% to 7.5%
items.quote: As of now, we have a visibility to close the year with an operating margin of over 6.5% for segment II in financial year FY27. As far as segment I is concerned, the margin outlook remains the same, 6.5% to 7%.

items.statement: Segment I FY27 operating margin outlook 6.5% to 7%
items.quote: As far as segment I is concerned, the margin outlook remains the same, 6.5% to 7%.

items.statement: Data center MEP order inflow FY27 ~Rs.3,000 Crore; revenue ~Rs.1,350 Crore
items.value: Rs.3,000 Crore order inflow, Rs.1,350 Crore revenue
items.quote: This financial year, you can take that our order inflow will be Rs.3,000 Crore, and our revenue will be Rs.1,350 Crore from segment alone.

items.statement: Data center MEP next year order inflow ~Rs.4,500 Crore; revenue ~Rs.2,100 Crore
items.value: Rs.4,500 Crore order inflow, Rs.2,100 Crore revenue
items.quote: This is likely to become an order inflow of around Rs.4,500 Crore next year and around Rs.2,100 Crore of revenue next year.

items.statement: Data center MEP to constitute ~20% of revenue at ~Rs.4,000 Crore by FY29
items.quote: As I had stated, the data center MEP projects will constitute close to 20% of our revenue at around RS.4,000 Crore coming from the data center MEP projects alone by FY29.

items.statement: Export revenue target additional USD100 million per annum from FY28
items.quote: With product approvals in place for a few customers, we are looking to scale this business to generate additional export revenue of USD100 million per annum from FY28.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 capex ~Rs.60-70 Crore; full-year FY27 growth-related spend ~Rs.300-350 Crore
items.quote: In Q1, the capex has been in the region of around Rs.60 Crore to Rs.70 Crore. items.statement: Carried forward order book Rs.7,764 Crore as on June 30, 2026, up 13.5% YoY
items.quote: The carry forward order book as on June 30, 2026, grew by 13.5% to Rs.7,764 Crore as compared to RS.6,843 Crore as on June 30, 2025.

items.statement: Full-year FY27 EBITDA margin expected at 8% to 8.5%, with Q3/Q4 reaching 9% to 9.5% as pricing actions take effect.
items.quote: I think we would tone it down to around 8% to 8.5% for this full year because we see this margin pressure to continue in Q2 also and normalize in Q3 and Q4.

items.statement: Switchgear capacity sufficient for 23-25% growth in FY27; balancing capex needed in FY28. Wire & Cable capacity sufficient for another year.
items.quote: I think this year's growth projection of close to 23% to 25%, which we will be able to do in the same capacity. Going forward, I think next year, we might have to do some balancing capacity for the Switchgear.

items.statement: FY27 capex minimal at INR15-16 crores for maintenance; additional minor capex for Saudi plant and Hosur expansion. No major capex for Smart Meter or EV charging.
items.quote: I think FY27 is going to be minimum, not the major capex that we are going to do except for the regular balancing and maintenance capex, which will be approximately, if I take it right, close to around INR15 crores or INR16 crores.

items.statement: Three price hikes in last six months (Feb, Mar, May, Jun); June hike effective August, August hike planned for September. Pass-through lag compressed switchgear margin by 4-5%.
items.quote: We have done almost three price increases over the last six months. However, as we do the price increase, we always accumulate the pending orders, which -- so the price increase comes into effect after the already orders that have been taken.

items.statement: Healthy underlying demand across industrial switchgear, wires & cables, building products; 7-8% volume growth in Q1, rest from price increases.
items.quote: I think this quarter, we have had 7% to 8% of volume growth and the rest is the growth because of the price increase.

items.statement: Export share 19% in Q1 FY27, targeting 25% medium term. Saudi plant start delayed to Sep-Oct; FY28 revenue ~INR25 crores. EV chargers: 60 units expected in Q2. Smart Meter drag continues, no major update.
items.quote: Our export contribution currently stands at approximately 19% in Q1 FY27, and we are working towards increasing this to back to 25% over the medium term.

items.statement: Smart Meter finished goods and pending orders awaiting customer clearance; Tamil Nadu tender cancelled, new tenders expected in coming months.
items.quote: Yes. We also have pending order, and we also have finished goods, but we are waiting for the clearance from the customer for dispatch.

items.statement: Kaycee Industries revenue grew 8% YoY to ~INR60 crores; PAT INR1 crore in Q1; 27% CAGR over 4 years, expected to continue for 3-4 years.
items.quote: Kaycee's top line grew 8% year-on-year in Q1 FY27. EBITDA stood at INR2 crores and PAT at INR1 crore during the quarter ended.

items.statement: Full year capex guidance of INR 6,000 crores plus/minus 10%
items.quote: We spent INR 1,614 crores on capex in the first quarter, in-line with our full year guidance of INR 6,000 crores, plus/minus 10%.

items.statement: Consumer electronics third facility capex approximately INR 65 billion over 3 years for 40 million units annual capacity
items.quote: Capex for this third facility is e xpected to be approximately INR 65 billion spread over a period of 3 years, building manufacturing capacity of 40 million units annually at full

items.statement: Total consumer electronics capex including GF1, GF2, GF3 around INR 7,500 crores, one-third incurred, balance over next 2-3 years
items.quote: The overall capex, including what we have already incurred in this facility, including GF 1, GF 2 and GF 3, should be around INR 7,500 crores.

items.statement: Aerospace order book grew more than 17% since FY26 end
items.quote: Our Aerospace business delivered revenue growth of over 20% year -on-year, while the order book grew by more than 17% since FY '26 end, giving us strong visibility on future growth.

items.statement: EBITDA margin improved 60 basis points year-on-year driven by modules and polymer restructuring
items.quote: EBITDA grew by 26% during the quarter, ahead of revenue growth, with EBITDA margin improving by 60 basis points year -on-year.

items.statement: Copper prices up 4% sequentially and 40% year-on-year with 1-2 quarter pass-through lag
items.quote: Copper prices continued to rise up 4% sequentially, following increases of 13% and 16% sequentially in the third quarter of FY '26 and the fourth quarter of FY '26, respectively. On a year -on-year basis, copper prices are now up 40%.

items.statement: Polymer prices in Germany up 55% year-on-year and 66% sequentially affecting MPP and Vision Systems
items.quote: Geopolitically driven crude price inflation also pushed polymer prices in Germany up by 55% year -on-year and 66% sequentially.

items.statement: Global light vehicle industry de-grew 1.8% year-on-year; South Asia led by India strong growth; European OEM launches expected to support growth
items.quote: Globally, the light vehicle industry de-grew by 1.8% year-on-year during the quarter, led by weaknesses in China, the largest automotive market, which de-grew by 3.1%.

items.statement: Commercial vehicle industry grew 5.4% year-on-year with favorable outlook through FY27
items.quote: On the commercial vehicle side, a recovery in North American market has sustained the CV industry's growth momentum, which is estimated to have grown 5.4% year -on-year. The outlook for the CV industry remains favorable through FY '27.

items.statement: Acquired Shenzhen Autocruis for interior/exterior digital vision systems; completed Nexans Autoelectric and Yutaka Giken acquisitions in July
items.quote: We announced the acquisition of Shenzhen Auto cruis, a company primarily engaged in interior and exterior digital vision and monitoring systems.

items.statement: Freight costs up 40% year-on-year and 83% sequentially; additional costs incurred for timely delivery
items.quote: Freight costs were similarly affected , with the World Container Index up 40% year-on-year and 83% sequentially.

items.statement: Leverage ratio at all-time low of 0.8x, well within financial policy ceiling of 2.5x and internal aspiration below 1.5x
items.quote: Our leverage ratio is now at an all -time low of 0.8x, well within our financial policy ceiling of 2.5x and our internal aspiration of staying below 1.5x.

items.statement: Nexans and Yutaka acquisitions to contribute close to USD 2 billion annualized revenue; mid-term margins to reflect comparable industry benchmarks
items.quote: Both of these businesses put together, Yutaka and Nexans should contribute almost close to USD 2 billion to our top -line on annualized basis.

items.statement: Consumer electronics JV partner holds 10% equity with option to go up to 49%; Motherson funding 90% of equity
items.quote: Our joint venture partner does have 10%. So they are bringing 10% of their equity. They do have an opportunity to go up to 49% , but at the moment they are holding that 10%.

items.statement: Emerging businesses clubbed together at infancy stage; will bifurcate for detailed view once meaningful in size
items.quote: If you look in the emerging businesses, we are clubbing a lot of different businesses together right now because they're all at the infancy stage.

items.statement: Health and medical business commissioned largest plant in Chennai; expects reversal of negative trend in coming quarters
items.quote: We've opened up our first plant in Chennai, which is the largest plant that we have for health and medical, which is gaining orders. And hopefully, this trend that you see of the negative should reverse in coming quarters.

items.statement: Reiterate FY27 guidance for double-digit revenue growth, EBITDA margins north of 21%, and absolute EBITDA in excess of 8000 crores with potential upside from strategic businesses
items.quote: We continue to reiterate our FY27 guidance to double -digit revenue growth, with EBITDA margins north of 21% and absolute EBITDA in excess of 8000, with potential upside driven by positive outperformance in our high-value strategic business areas.

items.statement: Net CapEx for Q1 FY27 stood at $78 million, focused mainly on TheraNym Biologics
items.quote: Net CapEx for the quarter stood at $78 million. Capital expenditure remained focused mainly towards TheraNym Biologics .

items.statement: Consolidated gross margin improved to 60.4% in Q1 FY27 from 58.8% in Q1 FY26 due to improved business mix and operating efficiency
items.quote: Gross margin remained resilient at 60.4% compared to 58.8% of Q1 FY26, benefiting from an improved business mix and operating efficiency.

items.statement: Europe business achieved 20% EBITDA margin in Q1 FY27
items.quote: Yeah, yeah, we have achieved the 20%. If you recollect, Shyam, we have been a single digit some three, four years back and Murali and the team as well as the accelerated captive supply and other things, cost reduction programs, etc. done by the team, we have achieved 20%.

items.statement: China OSD facility expected to turn EBITDA positive in FY27 after a loss of around $7 million last year
items.quote: So the margin front from China, last year we had a loss of around 7 million EBITDA. This year we should be doing better than, I mean, we should be doing positive. That is what I can tell at this stage.

items.statement: TheraNym CMO business expected to achieve EBITDA margins of 35-50% at scale
items.quote: And the margins in this business typically are around, the EBITDA margins will be around 35 to 50 %. Now, this depends again on the product mix that we are going to work towards.

items.statement: US revenues grew 8.1% YoY to Rs. 3,770 crores ($399 million) in Q1 FY27 with 10 new product launches, 9 ANDA filings, and 10 final approvals
items.quote: U.S. revenues grew by 8.1% year-on-year to Rs. 3,770 crores or $399 million reflecting the resilience of our base business. We launched 10 new products this quarter. Filed 9 ANDAs, received 10 final approvals, indicating strong pipeline execution and regulatory momentum.

items.statement: Europe revenues reached €267 million with 11% YoY constant currency growth in Q1 FY27, tracking double-digit growth for FY27
items.quote: Our European business continued its strong trajectory with revenues reaching €267 million, delivering 11% year-on-year growth in constant currency terms.

items.statement: Growth markets revenues increased 38% YoY to Rs. 1,063 crores ($113 million) in Q1 FY27 with broad-based performance across countries including new markets Indonesia, China, and Canada
items.quote: Growth markets revenues increased by 38% year-on-year to Rs. 1,063 crores or $113 million, supported by strong underlying performance across key markets.

items.statement: Formulation business grew 17% YoY to Rs. 8,101 crores (89% of consolidated revenue) in Q1 FY27; API business at Rs. 1,049 crores (11% of revenue)
items.quote: Our formulation business remained a primary growth driver, growing 17% year -on-year to Rs. 8,101 crores and contributing approximately 89% of the consolidated revenues, supported by growth across all key markets.

items.statement: Eugia injectables revenue expected to grow single-digit in FY27 to around $500 million+ due to lack of new approvals from Unit 3 under remediation
items.quote: This year has been a steady growth, but it is not going to be double digit. It will be single digit because of lack of new approvals, both from unit, mainly from unit three. And we are working with various consultants to do the remediation of unit three. So it is a, this year we expect that the single digit growth will continue. And we will clock around 500 million plus revenue for the year.

items.statement: Biosimilar pipeline on track: 7-8 products in EU/UK/Canada by 2028-29 with 4 approvals already; 2-3 US filings imminent this year supporting goal of at least 3 US products by 2030
items.quote: So, broadly, to summarize this, my guidance for a broader seven to eight products in EU, UK, Canada by 28-29 is on track with four approvals already received. Aurobindo Pharma Limited 06 August 2026 10 On the US side, the two or three product filings this year is imminent, which means that the guidance that I provided earlier about at least three products in the US by 2030, we are truly on track w

items.statement: TheraNym Unit 1 (Merck anchor) validation batches in 2027, steady revenue stream expected from 2028; Unit 2 (drug substance) commissioned by end-2029, revenue from 2031
items.quote: So, in a nutshell, the structure for TheraNym is designed specifically to de-risk the CapEx ramp with contracted volumes from unit one, providing revenue visibility from 2028 onwards, before the full capital cycle of unit two completes and unit two will start generating revenues from 2031

items.statement: TheraNym CMO revenue guidance of $150-200 million by 2032 from Unit 1 and Unit 2 combined
items.quote: So put together, Unit 1 and Unit 2, 2032, you should be looking at around US$150 to $200 million as a good case for the contract manufacturing business between Unit 1 and Unit 2.

items.statement: Net effective tax rate at 31.9% in Q1 FY27 due to not taking tax credit on loss-making subsidiaries; expected to normalize to 28-29% by year-end
items.quote: Our net effective tax rate is 31.9% on account of not taking the tax credit on loss-making subsidiaries. However, we expect the tax rate to normalise around 28 -29% by year-end.

items.statement: Lannett controlled substance growth limited by DEA quota allocations; incremental sales expected to be driven by new respiratory launches
items.quote: So, Lannett had that opportunity. They have ramped up a bit. They continue to do that. That's all I can say for now , as far as , the ramp up is concerned, as far as , the increases are concerned. The market, when it expands, the quota will expand. It's not like the other products. The quotas are very limited. They are very careful because these are all controlled substances.

items.statement: R&D expenses for Q1 FY27 at Rs. 344 crores (~4% of revenue); FY27 guidance of Rs. 1,450-1,500 crores as Phase 3 clinical studies largely completed
items.quote: And this year it will be somewhere around Rs. 1,450 to 1,500, that's the maximum we have seen. Because most of the products he has completed and he is in the filing and then implementation stage.

items.statement: Past 12-month revenue growth of 14.38% implies INR2,730 crores by 2031; aspirational vision is INR3,000 crores, INR2,500 crores looks too low
items.quote: if you look at our past 12-months revenue growth of exactly 14.38%, we would hit INR2,730 crores by 2031. So, I think I really leave it to all of you to do the calculation of whether it's INR2,700 crores or whether it's INR3,000 crores, but I would like to highlight that we've already shown a track record, past 12-months track record of INR2,730 crores.

items.statement: Total capex program INR270 crores; INR60 crores already spent, INR100 crores ordered or in process; Unitec JV investment INR110 crores for INR130 crores capacity, commissioning by April 2027
items.quote: So basically it's a total of INR270 crores. INR60 crores has already happened, another INR100 crores is either already ordered or in the process of being ordered. We will be using all this capex that we passed.

items.statement: Lifetime nominated business increased from INR800 crores to INR1,100 crores driven by new US Corvette program and other nominations
items.quote: So that alone has taken the INR800 crores to INR1,100 crores, and then there are going to be a lot more, and there are a lot more other nominations which have been converted.

items.statement: MTR aerospace defense order book currently INR25-30 crores; total defense including non-aerospace around INR50 crores
items.quote: the current order book is INR25 crores, not taking into account, a few more orders that we've received on the spherical bearings. So you're talking about maybe INR30 crores or something like that currently in hand.

items.statement: Margins expected to move between 18% and 20% over annual periods; not quarter-driven, trajectory maintained by design of high-margin businesses
items.quote: I have repeatedly said that our margins are between 18% to 20%. The reason I say that, and I keep reiterating it, we are not a quarterly driven company, and we don't want to be a quarter-by-quarter driven company.

items.statement: Other expenses up INR10 crores due to electricity, logistics, and petroleum product cost escalation; addressing via VAVE, cost reduction, and price increases
items.quote: it basically constitutes cost escalation in terms of electricity, cost escalation in terms of logistics, all that the newspapers are full of, right? Is it something that we're dealing with? Well, we have a combination of VAVE, which is, value engineering and cost reduction in the plants and price increases to deal with this.

items.statement: Industrial business at 14% of revenue, grew 34% YoY, targeting 20-25% long-term; EV-agnostic strategy focused on common applications across ICE, hybrid, EV
items.quote: Our industrial business is 14% of our total now. It's grown steadily from 11% to 14%. Our growth was 34% in industrial. So I think that answers your first question.

items.statement: Strategic pivot across six vectors: aerospace, automotive adjacencies, electrification beyond EV, mobility beyond vehicles, off-highway heavy-duty, mission-critical friction solutions; R&D-driven customized solutions
items.quote: We are strategically broadening our addressable market across six vital vectors. Many of these are between USD10 billion to USD14 billion market opportunities.

items.statement: Aerospace revenue timing hard to predict due to certification and customer order cycles; conservative guidance approach avoids quarterly predictions
items.quote: It's very hard to predict in the aerospace field. I mean, like, we mentioned recently we got the Sukhoi-30 order for a plain spherical bearing. Now this is a breakthrough order. There are a handful of companies in the world, not even five, that can make this type of bearing, okay?

items.statement: Secured production order for high-precision planet pins for GM Corvette program via NRB USA facility in Columbia, South Carolina; first win for US plant, validates Make in USA strategy
items.quote: We secured a production order to supply high-precision planet pins for a prestigious General Motors Corvette program through a leading tier one transmission manufacturer who is our existing customer.

items.statement: Mahant Tool Room core team retained; Mr. Mallappa leads aerospace defense segment, integrated into NRB supply chain management
items.quote: Very much so. In fact, that was one of the reasons for the acquisition. And Mr. Mallappa now leads our aerospace defense segment, and is very much an integrated part of the NRB supply chain management.

items.statement: Unitec JV location moved from Hyderabad to Aurangabad (Shendra); purchased partly ready facility to meet April 2027 commissioning timeline
items.quote: we've already purchased the land with a partially ready building for the joint venture in the Aurangabad in Shendra region actually.

items.statement: Data center bearings in R&D stage, no concrete announcement yet; working on robotics, humanoids, automation with orders like HAAS Automation (~250k each) building new vertical
items.quote: Data centers is a whole new line of bearings and we are in the product development stage, so I don't think that we have anything concrete that we are ready to announce.

items.statement: No concrete plan to merge SNL Bearings; subsidiary retains proprietary tech, brand, entrepreneurial culture, serves price-sensitive replacement market
items.quote: So we do not have a concrete plan to merge it at this moment. There is a lot of proprietary technology that they have, which is very beneficial if they are in their own niche space.

items.statement: Consolidated double-digit revenue growth with EBITDA margin 12%-13.5% for FY27
items.quote: we have said that on a consolidated basis, we will grow in double digits and that the EBITDA margin range would be these are all operational numbers you are talking, 12% to 13.5%.

items.statement: GCM double-digit revenue growth with EBITDA margin 10%-12% for FY27
items.quote: Global Cables and Mechatronics will also have a double-digit growth with the EBITDA margin operationally at between 10% to 12%.

items.statement: ICM EBITDA margin around 15% for FY27
items.quote: ICM, we have said around the last year's number, which is, I think, about 5%, 15%.

items.statement: PLE EBITDA margin around 12% for FY27
items.quote: PLD, that is Phoenix Lightin g and Electricals, we have again said around last year, which is about 12

items.statement: SED EBITDA margin touching 10% for FY27
items.quote: SED, we have said, again, in line with the last year, which was touching 10%. So, basically, we are aiming to do the 10% again.

items.statement: GCM EBITDA margin improved from 5.8% to 12.6% in Q1 FY27
items.quote: First of all, the revenue went up by 27% almost 28% and EBITDA moved very smartly from 5.8% to 12.6%.

items.statement: ICM EBITDA margin declined from 15% to 13% in Q1 FY27 due to cost pressures
items.quote: But EBITDA grew only by 4.2% with the margins down from almost 15% to 13%.

items.statement: PLE EBITDA margin declined from 6.7% to 2.8% in Q1 FY27 due to delayed price increases
items.quote: Margins went down 2.8% to 6.7%, primarily due to delayed price increases and in particularly in the aftermarket business.

items.statement: Standalone EBITDA margin under pressure, expected recovery in Q2-Q3 FY27
items.quote: Stand-alone margins came under pressure, and Mohan will be walking through that as to what happened and how it's going to be a temporary phenomenon for us.

items.statement: Raw material and wage cost increases pressuring ICM and PLE margins; pass-through discussions ongoing
items.quote: While we have mechanisms with our customers to tackle with the material cost increases, employee cost increase has been a different angle for us. And for the first time in many years, we have approached the customers to pass this on to.

items.statement: India automotive sector grew ~22% in Q1 FY27 with double-digit growth in PV and 2-wheeler segments
items.quote: India had a very good quarter in terms of the automotive numbers with the sector growing at about 22% and both passenger vehicle and 2-wheeler segments had a solid double-digit growth.

items.statement: GCM seeing strong double-digit growth in Q2 FY27 despite global auto being flat
items.quote: But compared to last, still strong double-digit growth for this quarter also for GCM.

items.statement: Three major GCM order wins announced: largest EV cable contract USD 5M annualized (USD 37M lifetime), European luxury OEM USD 2M annualized (USD 12M lifetime), Japanese OEM USD 1.2M annualized (USD 6M lifetime)
items.quote: One is the largest EV cable contract, which is an annualized value of USD 5 million and a lifetime of about USD 37 million. Second one is a European luxury OEM, which is at USD 2 million a year, a lifetime of USD 12 million. And another one is from a Japanese OEM, again, USD 1.2 million a year, lifetime of USD 6 million.

items.statement: Chinese OEM awarded nearly 25 cable projects, 5-6 launched, rest launching over next 12 months
items.quote: I think we have won nearly 25 different, different cable projects with this customer. And I think five or six of them have been launched already, and the balance w ill be launched over the next 12 months or whatever time frame, depending upon the development time

items.statement: Electronics division relocating to larger leased premises and rebuilding current plant into multistory facility
items.quote: We have now decided to move out of the current location temporarily. We already found a larger leased out premises nearby. I think in the next, I don't know, the time line, maybe six months or so, we'll be completely relocating to that site and completely rebuilding the current plant by demolishing and coming out with a much larger facility for electronics.

items.statement: SED revenue up 48%, EBITDA up 100%, margins near double digits driven by digital clusters and electronic throttle grip
items.quote: Revenue is up 48%, EBITDA up 100%, margins close to double digits. This is because of a lot of new projects that ramped up very well in the quarter and will be continuing to ramp up.

items.statement: European competitor insolvency creates uncertainty for PLE; outcome unclear over next 3-6 months
items.quote: The insolvency in Europe, which is still an ongoing, they're still operating. There are some customers are trying to support them and all that stuff. The whole thing is still n ot yet fully rolled out as to how it will pan

items.statement: Revenue expected to increase by INR200-300 crores from new capacity plus existing revenue slightly higher than last year
items.quote: So all put together so that there will be a reasonable increase in our revenues.

items.statement: Fabric capacity expansion of 35 million meters and spinning capacity addition of 74,000 spindles progressing as scheduled
items.quote: Going forward, our -- one of our future growth driver will be our capacity addition, which is going -- progressing as schedule with the expansion of our fabric capacity by another 35 million meters and spinning capacity by additional 74,000 spindles.

items.statement: Weaving capacity to start in couple of months, processing around Diwali, spinning by December; full yarn ramp-up by March FY27, fabric may take quarter or two more in FY28
items.quote: I think we will start our weaving capacities in couple of month's time. We should be starting the same. Processing capacities will take then further one and a half more month to start which is around Diwali and spinning capacity should be on stream by around December.

items.statement: EBITDA margin improved to 17.78% in Q1 FY27 from 14.02% in Q1 FY26, driven by higher realizations and cost savings
items.quote: EBITDA margin for this quarter stood at 17.78% against Q1 FY26 margins of 14.02% is an increase of 376 bps on a year-on-year basis and 261 bps on quarter-on-quarter basis.

items.statement: Management maintains long-term margin guidance range of 16-20% and aims for upper end, but cannot guarantee reaching 20%
items.quote: I guided or have informed that the kind of product mix which our company has, we should be in the range of 16% to 20%. I still maintain the same, that we should be -- kind of product profile as well as the kind of cost metrics we have, we should be still remain in this range.

items.statement: Fabric business margin pass-through limited to raw material cost increase only, unlike yarn where 120-125% of cost increase passed through
items.quote: But in the case of fabric business only whatever raw material increase actually has happened in the cotton that is only getting passed on. We are not able to improve upon the margins as we are able to improve upon the margins in the yarn business.

items.statement: Yarn spreads increased from INR110 in Q4 FY26 to INR130 currently and sustaining in Q2
items.quote: In the first quarter, I think in the last quarter of the last financial year, the spreads were in the range of about INR110. And now it is in the range of or INR130.

items.statement: Cotton prices increased 8-10% in Q1 due to lower global production and logistics challenges; Indian cotton parity vs Cotlook Index improved from +5-7% to -1-2%
items.quote: Cotton prices increased during quarter 1 by about 8% to 10%, primarily driven by overall lower global production, global supply chain and logistics challenges due to West Asia war.

items.statement: Company passing on higher cotton costs in Q2; not relying solely on low-cost inventory
items.quote: We are not at all relying on our inventories alone. We are trying to pass on the increase in the raw material prices. This has happened in the past also and going forward also if the prices there is no abnormal increase in the raw material prices I think we should be in a position to pass on the increased cotton prices also.

items.statement: Demand improved from both domestic and export markets; China imports of Indian cotton yarn increased from 90-100M kg to 110-115M kg in CY26
items.quote: We used -- we were India was exporting in the range of 90 to 100 million kgs during the whole of year '25. In '26 in the calendar year '26 China started to import and it went up to 110 to 115 million.

items.statement: Knitted fabric utilization at 55-60%, below pre-US tariff levels of 60-65% due to ongoing US market uncertainties
items.quote: This is in the range of about 55% to 60% at this point of time. We have not yet reached the 65% level the usual utilization pre this US tariff regime used to be around 60% to 65%.

items.statement: New capacity: 60%+ yarn for internal fabric consumption, 40% for external sales; fabric revenue expected to grow from INR700+ crores to INR1,200 crores in FY28
items.quote: About 60% plus will go for our internal consumption, and the and balance will be for the sales. 40% will be for the sales.

items.statement: Fabric share of revenue to increase from 20-21% to ~30%, adding 100-150 bps to overall margins
items.quote: And this should add about 100 to 150 bps to our margins. So our overall margins may increase by this level.

items.statement: No buyback planned as company in growth phase deploying capital for expansion via internal accruals and loans
items.quote: I think at this point of time we are in a growth phase. We are deploying our capital for the growth purposes, internal accruals as well as we are also taking some loans as well. So it would not be some it would not be prudent for us to go for buyback at this point of time.

items.statement: Renewable power expansion on track to be operational by end of Q3 FY27; expected annual EBITDA savings of ~INR50 crores, with INR1.2-1.5 crores already realized in Q1
items.quote: I think annually it will be about it should at the EBITDA level it should be around 50 crores.

items.statement: Blended power cost expected to be ~INR5.50/unit once full solar capacity (60% of requirements) operational
items.quote: This should be once we have our complete capacity up and running, which would be constituting about 65% of our -- 60 to 60 -- about 60% of our overall requirements our blended cost should be in the range of about INR5.50.

items.statement: Q1 volume achieved 16% to 29% of full year FY27 guidance; company remains on track to deliver FY27 guidance
items.quote: We remain on track to deliver our FY '27 guidance, with Q1 volume achieving between 16% to 29% of full year guidance.

items.statement: Pellet production guidance of 4.0 million tons for FY27 likely to be slightly lower due to one plant shutdown; exact revised guidance to be communicated later
items.quote: Although we haven't revised, we are still evaluating but you can expect the volumes to be slightly on the lower side.

items.statement: Beneficiation plant capex of INR218 crores incurred till June 2026; CRM complex capex revised to INR1,100 crores (including working capital margin money) from earlier INR900-950 crores; BESS project capex INR501 crores incurred till date; t
items.quote: Overall we envisage a CapEx of close to about INR2,000 crores for remaining FY'27 and entire FY'28.

items.statement: Exported two vessels of pellets in June and July at INR9,000 ex-plant; open to export opportunities depending on domestic demand and pricing
items.quote: We did export two vessels in July -- in June and July, and then we had to stop exports because of shutting of our another pellet plant.

items.statement: EBITDA margin 19.1% and PAT margin 12.7% in Q1 FY27; margin improvement expected from Q4 FY27 after beneficiation plant commissioning; CRM complex margin expected to reach 10%-11% with Maharashtra incentives (up from 7%-8%)
items.quote: Except margin improvement, we expect margin improvement from Q4 FY '27, following commissioning of beneficiation plant, enabling greater utilization captive iron ore pellets.

items.statement: Iron ore prices expected to hover between USD90-100/ton globally and INR5,500 ex-mine domestically; pellet prices INR9,000-11,000/ton (currently ~INR10,000); imported coal cost rose from INR10,500 to INR13,000/ton due to West Asia crisis; g
items.quote: Globally, iron ore prices remain resilient, close to about $95 tons to $105 tons, supported by healthy mill margin and inventory restocking, despite peaking Chinese steel consumption.

items.statement: Pellet demand was dull in June-July with prices below INR9,000; revived in last 2-3 weeks with prices up ~10%; India steel demand outlook strong driven by infrastructure, housing, railway, manufacturing; industry utilization constrained at
items.quote: The demand was quite dull end of June, early July, the prices had touched COVID low of below INR9,000, and that was the reason we had to shut one of our plants because the operations were commercially unviable.

items.statement: Value-added products (sponge iron, billet, rolled) recorded healthy YoY growth in Q1; 4.7Mt pellet capacity at 77% utilization in Q1, expected to ramp to 80-85% in FY27; CRM complex (0.7Mt) relocation to Maharashtra targeted for Dec 2027 co
items.quote: The 4.7 million ton expanded pellet capacity operated at 77% utilization in Q1 and is expected to ramp up to around 80%-85% in FY '27 as the operations scale up.

items.statement: Integrated steel plant (1Mt) kept in abeyance due to water allocation delays (6-8 months); now optional for medium term; Ari Dongri mining constrained by government land tree-cutting approval (expected by end Sep); 150MW solar project in ab

items.statement: CRM complex funded via INR550 crores debt and balance through internal accruals; no new debt needed for current projects as steel plant on hold; sufficient free cash flows to fund entire capex
items.quote: Since it's on hold now, so we don't need to borrow any money for funding our current projects. We are very much -- we have sufficient free cash flows to fund the entire projects now.

items.statement: Management confident of sustaining double-digit EBITDA margin on full year basis and accelerating FY28 revenue target of INR6,000 crores
items.quote: We remain confident of sustaining the double-digit EBITDA margin on a full year basis as well.

items.statement: Target to reach 10-12% EBITDA margin by FY28 with business inherently capable of generating 10-12% EBITDA margin
items.quote: As we have guided earlier, our first aim is to really target between 10% to 12% by FY28.

items.statement: CAGR target of 12-14% but current traction suggests better than that range for FY27
items.quote: In terms of top line, we have been always saying that our CAGR would be in the range of 12% to 14%. But if you look at better years, we have done more than that.

items.statement: Capex commitment of approximately INR200-250 crores for FY27 across geographies with detailed plan to be shared in coming months
items.quote: Further, we are in the process of outlining capex commitment of approximately INR200 to INR250 crores for FY27 across geographies.

items.statement: Healthy order book with better capacity utilization in India compared to last year when tariff pressure started
items.quote: At Pearl, we are having a healthy order book and have better utilization of capacity in India as compared to last year when we had the backdrop of the tariff pressure which had started around this time.

items.statement: Adjusted EBITDA margin at 10.7% in Q1 FY27, up 140 bps YoY, confident of sustaining this margin in Q1 series of subsequent years
items.quote: Adjusted EBITDA margin stood at 10.7%, up by 140 bps year-on-year. It is pertinent to note that given the current customer m ix, product mix, and geographical contribution to revenue and margin in quarter 1 of FY27, we are confident of sustaining this margin in Q1 series of subsequent year as well

items.statement: Standalone EBITDA margin dropped to 6.6% due to 38% and 21% minimum wage hikes in Haryana and Noida, but target is high single-digit to double-digit
items.quote: The drop in EBITDA margin despite revenue growth is because of higher wage cost in all factories in Haryana post wage revision by state government.

items.statement: US implemented additional 10% tariff under Section 301 on India, Bangladesh, Indonesia and 12.5% on Vietnam over MFN tariff
items.quote: USA, our biggest market, has now an MFN plus Section 301 tariff on our apparel. As you know, after Supreme Court judge IEEPA tariff was not legal in February, US had implemented a 10% additional tariff under Section 122.

items.statement: US consumer behavior remains healthy despite geopolitical tensions, retailers getting refunds from IEEPA tariff strike-down which should positively impact order books
items.quote: On the brighter side, what we find is that despite all these war and inflation, the US consumer behaviour remained healthy. We observe similar trends in other major Western markets as well like European Union and UK.

items.statement: Q1 realization higher at INR735 due to seasonal outerwear shipments, full year FY26 average was INR643, improvement driven by product mix
items.quote: Last year, we closed an average realization of INR643 per piece. And so, if you're comparing an average of full year with the quarter 1, that's maybe not the right comparison.

items.statement: Container shortages and shipping capacity constraints causing delays and high spot freight rates before peak season, Bab-el-Mandeb tensions adding pressure
items.quote: And in addition, like, you know, even before the peak shipping season, we are seeing a shortage of containers and the shipping lines capacity shortages resulting in delays and high spot prices of freight.

items.statement: Worker availability challenges in India during Q1 due to harvest season, school holidays, and West Bengal elections causing labor absenteeism
items.quote: In terms of challenges in India, we did face the challenge of worker availability during the Q1, majorly because of being a harvest season, school holidays, and this time also we had the West Bengal elections, we saw a lot of labors going missing or absent.

items.statement: Bangladesh capacity expansion of 6-7 million pieces additional capacity with sustainable laundry operations starting September, taking group installed capacity to ~108 million pieces
items.quote: Our ongoing capacity expansion projects in Bangladesh along with the sustainable laundry operations that we are starting in September and we should be becoming operational and execute orders in the second half of this year. These projects expected to give us almost about 6 to 7 million pieces of additional capacity in Bangladesh, and that will take our total group installed capacity to almost 108

items.statement: Bihar second shed construction commenced, completion expected in next couple of months, will add 450 machines for knit garments
items.quote: Construction in India, construction for the second shed, manufacturing shed in Bihar has already commenced. We are expecting completion in next couple of months.

items.statement: India-UK FTA effective July 15, 2026 and EU FTA targeted by beginning of 2027 expected to boost Indian exports and raw material investments
items.quote: The implementation of India-UK free trade agreement which went effective 15th of July 2026 is a significant positive development for Indian exports. Now the focus will be on the implementation of European Union FTA by the beginning of 2027.

items.statement: Guatemala operations reworked, confident of achieving break-even during FY27
items.quote: In Guatemala, we have reworked our operating strategy and seeing encouraging progress. We remain confident of achieving a break-even during this financial year of 2027.

items.statement: Aspiration to scale business 10x over next decade, implying ~20% annual growth
items.quote: As we have indicated, our aspiration is to scale the business 10x over the next decade.

items.statement: Targeting 10x growth in 10 years, which turns out to be about 20% a year
items.quote: So, we are seeing 10x growth in 10 years, which turns out to be about 20% a year is what we are looking at.

items.statement: Booked orders for Rs. 120-plus crore towards new wins and renewals for multiyear contracts in Q1 FY27
items.quote: During the quarter, ADSL has booked orders for Rs. 120-plus crore towards new wins as well as renewals for multiyear contracts.

items.statement: Opportunity pipeline remains healthy with robust customer engagement and participation in larger strategic transformation programs
items.quote: Our opportunity pipeline remains healthy. Customer engagement is robust, and we are increasingly participating in larger and more strategic transformation programs, including opportunities beyond our traditional partner ecosystem.

items.statement: Embedding AI across service portfolio to create differentiated outcome-driven offerings and improve service delivery optimization
items.quote: As we continue to embed AI across our services and solutions, we are not only enhancing operational efficiency but also creating differentiated outcome-driven offerings that will define the next phase of Allied Digital's growth.

items.statement: Investing in leadership team, talent base, AI capabilities, and sales engine for next phase of growth
items.quote: These initiatives are aimed to improve execution at scale, increasing our share of direct customer engagement, enhancing long-term competitiveness.

items.statement: Trailing 12-month revenue crossed Rs. 1,000 crore mark, reaching Rs. 1,009 crore
items.quote: Our trailing 12 months revenue have now crossed the Rs. 1,000 crore mark, reaching to Rs. 1,009 crore.

items.statement: Audit report unmodified with no qualifications for first time since comprehensive review commenced
items.quote: For the first time since the comprehensive review commenced, the audit report carries no qualifications or observations.

items.statement: Target INR1,000 crores direct-to-consumer revenue by FY29 with at least 15% operating margin from that segment
items.quote: We remain committed to achieving INR1,000 crores of direct -to-consumer revenue by FY29 with an operating margin of at least 15% from this segment.

items.statement: Expect working capital improvements of approximately INR250 crores and cash flow from operations of more than INR300 crores in FY27
items.quote: The initiatives currently underway are expected to deliver working capital improvements of approximately INR250 crores in the current financial year and generate cash flow from operations of more than INR300 crores during the year.

items.statement: Project bottom line growth greater than 30% for FY27 despite muted revenue growth due to exiting unprofitable lines
items.quote: Our expectation is to -- that bottom line should grow more than 30% for the year.

items.statement: Plan to add 4 Jean Dousset retail stores in FY27, reaching 7 total by year-end
items.quote: During FY27, we intend to add 4 more locations.

items.statement: Jean Dousset store payback period less than 1 year, profitable by month 2-3
items.quote: Currently, based on the unit economics, we see a payback of less than 1 year for the JD stores.

items.statement: Jean Dousset brand grew about 30% in FY26 after acquisition
items.quote: For FY26, I think the brand after acquisition grew about 30%.

items.statement: Owned brands EBITDA margin improved to 11.5% from 10% in Q1 FY26

items.quote: Our margins year-over-year are down from 7.7% to 7.2%.

items.statement: Gold and silver price increases make inventory exit costs negligible or zero
items.quote: The exit costs from inventory is also almost negligible or 0, as the value of the inventory would have gone up due to the fact that the price of gold and silver has gone up meaningfully.

items.statement: WithClarity at INR220 crores revenue run rate growing at ~20%
items.quote: WithClarity is currently at a revenue run rate of about INR220-odd crores and it's growing at a healthy clip of about 20% or so.

items.statement: Focus on 3 power brands: Jean Dousset, WithClarity, and Disney license; rationalized other licenses and owned brands
items.quote: The 3 brands that will be most meaningful will be Jean Dousset, WithClarity and in the licensing segment, Disney.

items.statement: Tariff refund applications in process, amounts unknown, will share refunds with customers
items.quote: We are in the process of applying for tariff refunds and we do expect to get some refunds for tariffs. I think we will have to obviously share some of those refunds with our customers as well.

items.statement: Open to brand acquisitions given expected INR300+ crores operating cash flow in FY27
items.quote: we're open, nothing to report yet, but when there is something to report, we'll definitely announce it

items.statement: Working capital days reduced to 220 from 253 in Q1 FY26, a 33-day improvement
items.quote: Our working capital efficiency improved meaningfully during the quarter with working capital days reducing to 220 days from 253 days in Q1 FY26, representing an improvement of 33 days year-on-year.

items.statement: Plan to increase Jean Dousset stores to 13 by end of FY28 (7 in FY27, 6 more in FY28)
items.quote: Currently, our business plan is to get to 7 stores by the end of the current financial year. And then the plan would be to add 6 more stores in the following year.

items.statement: Aspiration to be a $2 billion revenue enterprise by FY30, targeting close to INR16,600 crores
items.quote: So you recall that we announced our aspiration to be a $2 billion revenue enterprise by FY30. But we are not going a year-wise breakup. So by FY30, we should be close to INR16,600 crores company.

items.statement: Endeavor to improve EBITDA margin from current levels, having improved by over 400 basis points in last 3 years
items.quote: So Mr. Bharat, our endeavor is to improve the ma rgin from here on. So even if you look at our journey for the last 3 years, we have improved our margin by more than 400 basis points, and we'll continue to work on margin improvement going forward also

items.quote: We received a landmark order from the oil and ga s segment for natural gas gensets across ratings up to 500
