items.statement: RegTech AI-based risk intelligence product proven with 650M transactions at 98% accuracy, no direct competition currently
items.quote: What we have built is the AI-based risk intelligence, which is completely new. And that can be only evolved if at all you are able to deploy that solution in the banking environment, which we did and we processed almost about 650 million transactions on it. So, we not only have product, we also have machine learning and we also have the data intelligence, which is at 98% accuracy.

items.statement: TimePay revival dependent on MDR impact on payer PSP revenue share
items.quote: Yes, TimePay, again, since this is B2C, we are still looking for the overall decision on MDR. If at all MDR has a direct impact on the payer revenue, which is the payer PSP also gets a share of that revenue, then for sure it will create an influx of opportunity on TimePay.

items.statement: Inorganic acquisitions not included in 60-70% CAGR guidance; targeting geographical access, new products, growth trajectory
items.quote: is a focused criteria right now. Because when it comes to priority, what we are looking at is the geographical access, instant access that we can get, new product that we can get, which is missing from our stack, which we wanted to build, and the growth trajectory that particular organization is giving right now

items.statement: Revenue growth guidance of over 25% for FY27, implying ~INR1,600 crores top line
items.quote: From a growth perspective, we remain confident of delivering a revenue growth of over 25% in FY27.

items.statement: Medium-term target of over 20% CAGR over next 3-4 years with progressive profitability improvement
items.quote: Based on our internal medium-term business plan, we are confident of achieving over 20% CAGR over the next three to four years, along with a progressive improvement in profitability.

items.statement: Order book at INR1,053 crores end of Q1 FY27, up 25% YoY; Phenix INR837 crores (79%), Proflex INR216 crores (21%)
items.quote: Order on hand stood at INR1,053 crores at the end of Q1FY27, representing approximately 25% year on year growth.

items.statement: Board approved INR30 crores for automated heavy structural steel line at Sanand adding 10,000 tons (12k to 22k tons), operational by Q1 FY28
items.quote: M&B is investing INR30 crores in a fully automated heavy structural steel processing line at the Sanand facility. The new line will add another 10,000 tons to our existing heavy structural capacity of 12,000 tons. It is expected to become operational by Q1 of FY28.

items.statement: Cheyyar brownfield expansion adding 20,000 tons PEB/structural capacity, completion planned Q3 FY28; total capacity ~154,000 tons by Q3 FY28
items.quote: We will also commence implementation of the brownfield expansion at Cheyyar during the current fiscal year with completion planned for Q3 of FY28. This expansion will add another 20,000 tons per annum of capacity and increase our total PEB and structural steel capacity to approximately 1,54,000 tons per annum effective

items.statement: Q1 FY27 operating EBITDA margin 11.4%; management targets improvement in H2 FY27 but defers specific guidance by one quarter due to cost volatility
items.quote: We want to improve it, however given the extremely volatile situation on the cost front, we have not given any specific guidance but we will give a specific guidance in the next quarter, but be clear the target is to improve over what we have achieved today.

items.statement: Export margins at 15% worst-case at current peak freight (USD10-12k/container), normal 16-17%; domestic ~11%; delta ~4-5% vs historical 8-9%
items.quote: At the current freight costs, assuming that nothing goes down, we still calculated that that should still give you around 15% EBITDA margins. Now, in a good situation, it could be 16%- 17%, in the worst situation, it is 15%.

items.statement: IPO proceeds utilization 57% (INR146.69 crores of INR259.32 crores) as of June 30, 2026; INR8.88 crores utilized in Q1 FY27
items.quote: Out of the net IPO proceeds of INR259.32 crores, INR146.69 crores have been utilized so far, that is 57% of the funds have been utilized as on 30th June 2026. During the quarter, INR8.88 crores was utilized out of the IPO proceeds.

items.statement: Targets INR3,000 crores turnover in about 3 years, maximum before 5 years, with ~30% YoY growth and INR1,000 crores PAT
items.quote: My turnover of INR3000 crores in about 3 years and I will achieve it maximum before 5 years. And I will main tain a growth of about 30% year-on-year

items.statement: Aims for 27-30% net profit margin and 40%+ EBITDA margin in future
items.quote: I would like to remain a company with 27% to 30% net profit and EBITDA of 40% plus in future also.

items.statement: Plans 3,000-3,500 operational beds in FY27, up from 2,400 currently; targets 7,000-10,000 beds in 3-5 years
items.quote: In FY27, I had said I will do 3,000 to 3,500 operational beds. I will do 3,000 plus this year. We will do 3,000 to 3,500, and in three to five years, I have given the number of 7,000 to 10,000.

items.statement: Product revenue steady at INR118 crores in Q1 FY27; OTC sales up INR3 crores QoQ; Entero distribution to start within 15 days
items.quote: medicine sales were INR80 crore s in Q1 and INR118 crores in Q4, and this quarter too it is INR118 crores. So product business is steady

items.statement: Total patient touchpoints grew 10% QoQ to 534,000 in Q1 FY27; daycare volume up 31% YoY to 19,400; e-commerce orders up to 264,000
items.quote: In the last quarter, a total of 4,87,000 people connected with us across OPD, IPD, daycare, COD, e-commerce, and consultations. If I look at quarter 4 to quarter 1, then 5,34,000 people are connected to us in this quarter.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin 41%, PAT margin 28%; one-time other income of INR7 crores (INR5 cr warrant valuation, INR2.5 cr capital gains)
items.quote: In this quarter, our revenue from operations stood at INR224 crores, while EBITDA was INR92 crores and PAT was INR65 crore s. We delivered a 41% EBITDA margin and a 28% PAT margin

items.statement: Deliberately reduced government/credit business from INR15 crores to INR5 crores to avoid receivables risk; building cash-rich model
items.quote: I have reduced government business. If I continue business where money gets stuck in receivables, that bad debt risk persists. When you look quarter-on-quarter, I have scaled down government business to one-third on a yearly and quarter-on-quarter basis, while maintaining and regularly growing our private business.

items.statement: Ultra-luxury wellness center in Manali (108 rooms + 22 villas) starting Sep-Oct; leased 3-year renewable contract; minimal operating cost (only marketing & doctor wages)
items.quote: Its name will be, sir, Jeena Sikho Premium. We are planning that. Arjuna Wellness was its name earlier, so that name is coming in the agreement.

items.statement: Manali center: Year 1 - 50% occupancy, ADR INR32-35k, EBITDA 35-40%; Year 2 - 60% occupancy, ADR INR35-37k, gross margin 60-62%, operating cost 9-10%
items.quote: With an average occupancy expected for the first 12 business months would be 50%, with an ADR of 32,000 to 35,000, and with overall gross margins of around 50% to 55%, with an EBITDA coming to approximately 35% to 40% plus for year one.

items.statement: Plans 3-4 similar luxury wellness centers across India, each targeting INR3-5 crores net profit
items.quote: We are looking for more such deals in India, so we are planning to launch three to four such luxury premium wellness in four different corners of all over India, which will give us at least around INR3 crores to INR5 crores profit from each center, as we have thought. Net profit.

items.statement: IPD patients up 33% YoY to 11,500; daycare volume up 31% YoY; OPD/consultation volume up 143% YoY; ticket size reduced for affordability
items.quote: Within our Ayurveda healthcare service business, underlying demand remained strong, with Panchakarma revenue growing 13% in Q1 FY27, supported by a 33% YoY increase in IPD patients and a 31% increase in day care volume.

items.statement: Reduced ticket size for underprivileged patients; launching discounted scheme for BPL/Ayushman patients at INR4,000-5,000 per bed to boost occupancy
items.quote: We have made it a little cheaper for the poor man. That is one factor. The poor man who is unable to pay, we have started a new segment for him to give a discount.

items.statement: Entered partnership with Entero Healthcare; products to appear across all distributors within 15 days after completed testing and software integration
items.quote: They have completed their testing, and within 15 days, our products will start appearing across all their distributors. Their software integration and testing took the last 2 months.

items.statement: Satkartar partnership active; will run new ads and direct patients for admissions once ads ready
items.quote: Meetings with Satkartar are ongoing regularly. As soon as our new advertisement is ready, Satkartar will run it and direct patients to us for admission. That agreement is active and sustained; there is no issue with it.

items.statement: ZeroTouch expected to contribute 20-22% of revenue within next two years
items.quote: So, we are planning to achieve this target by maximum in two years. So, this year will have a very good potential coming into this financial year and the next financial also will achieve a greater.

items.statement: Expect minimum Rs. 5-6 crore ZeroTouch orders in current financial year
items.quote: The upcoming, as per your questions, on this year, we are expecting to have a minimum Rs. 5 crores to Rs. 6 crores order on ZeroTouch in this year only.

items.statement: Current order book stands at Rs. 75 crore for next two years including ARAM contracts
items.quote: So, we have as of now Rs. 75 crore order book for the next two years. That is the new order as well as our ARAM, which is our long-term contract with the government

items.statement: ZeroTouch EBITDA margin expected at 55-60% vs traditional ERP business
items.quote: From ZeroTouch, EBITDA margin is expected to be between 55% to 60% compared to the ERP.

items.statement: Target consolidated EBITDA margin range of 42-46% over next few years
items.quote: So, our focus has always been to range between 42% to 46%.

items.statement: Revenue split 60% education ERP, 40% manufacturing ERP in Q1 FY27
items.quote: So, last, we have a like total revenue is distributed into the, 60% is coming from our education ERP and entire vertical of education and 40% is coming from the manufacturing.

items.statement: ZeroTouch currently has only pilot orders; confirmed orders awaited from university and government tenders
items.quote: As of now, we have only pilot orders and the confirmed orders, we have bidded the tender and we are in process of it.

items.statement: LLM-based AI features to launch to existing customers in Q3 FY27; revenue expected before March 31, 2027
items.quote: So, for the 2 nd Quarter of this year, sorry, 3 rd Quarter of this year, we want to launch that is our timeline EBITDA launching, sorry, BITA launching into our existing customers. And by end of this financial year, we are expecting to start our revenue

items.statement: Strategic acquisition plan focused on technology, education, FinTech, AI and data center with disciplined approach
items.quote: So, we are currently planning to have a strategic acquisition for various focus areas that is technology, education, FinTech, AI and data center. These are the five areas.

items.statement: Intangible assets at Rs. 10 crore; may increase 10-20% with two products under development
items.quote: So, sir, as of now, we have a total Rs. 10 crore intangible assets, that is including of hardware machine of ZeroTouch, the software part of the ZeroTouch, and complete AI engines, what we are building.

items.statement: ZeroTouch follows DaaS model charging per question paper printed and delivered
items.quote: The ZeroTouch machine is completely DaaS model. So, device is a service. So, we are not selling this machine to any of our institutes or any customers. We provide completely end-to-end service.

items.statement: AI LLM features initially free with query limits; paid plans for additional queries
items.quote: So, our revenue model will be initially to stick to open them in free, number of requests will be free in the initial stage and top up to that they can buy a plan to have more queries.

items.statement: Q1 revenue declined ~25% sequentially due to seasonal business patterns
items.quote: It will be compared to the last quarter; it is around 30%. Pravesh Saxena: 30%? Bhaveshkumar Gadhethriya: Sorry, 25

items.statement: Major AI LLM investment already made; additional 15-20% capitalization expected for training and deployment
items.quote: So, major part of the investment we have already done like building our LLM and all the things. Now, as I mentioned to your previous questions around 15% to 20% will be add-on to train them and making it to the live.

items.statement: Sales and marketing team expanded to Chandigarh, Odisha, Bihar, Jaipur, Pune, Mumbai, Indore, Bhopal, Gujarat, Rajkot
items.quote: we have expanded our team to Chandigarh. So, we are now present in Punjab and Haryana, we have expanded our team into the Odisha, we are into Bihar, we have a team in Patna, we have a team in Jaipur, Pune, Mumbai, we have a team in Indore, Bhopal

items.statement: Expect EBITDA margins to improve to 14-15% in Q2 FY27 and reach 18-20% run rate by Q4 FY27, subject to stable raw material prices
items.quote: Accordingly, we expect EBITDA margins to improve to between 14% to 15% in Q2 FY27 and reach the normal state of 18% to 20% on a run rate basis by Q4 '27, subject to raw material prices remaining broadly stable.

items.statement: Expect full-year FY27 volume growth of 8-10% and revenue growth in high teens
items.quote: So, the volume growth estimate for full year would be close to, between 8% and 10%, I think. Minimum. More, actually it is closer to 10%.

items.statement: Expect FY28 standalone volume growth of 13-14% and price realization growth of 3-4%
items.quote: So roughly 13% to 14% should come from volume and 3% to 4% should come from price realization for the next year.

items.statement: Expect FY28 revenue growth of mid to high teens on standalone basis
items.quote: Yes, so FY28 we expect a growth of again mid to high teens.

items.statement: New capacity of 1.5 million helmets annually expected operational from September-October; current utilization 81% at 1.95 million units
items.quote: Our first phase of 1.5 million helmets of additional annual capacity is progressing as planned and is expected to become operational beginning October and September.

items.statement: Raw material cost impact expected to soften from 600bps in Q1 to ~300bps in Q2; further improvement in Q3-Q4 as styrene prices moderate
items.period: Q2 FY27, Q3 FY27, Q4 FY27
items.quote: On the raw material side, we had an impact as you said, was 600 bps for Q1. We expect this to soften, close to 300 bps in this quarter. And then as material prices soften, we expect Q3 and Q4 to be better.

items.statement: Added 27 new COCO stores in Q1 FY27, total network now 165 stores across 100 cities; on track for 80 COCO store additions in FY27
items.quote: We remain on track to achieve our target of adding about 80 company-owned, company-operated stores during FY27.

items.statement: Gross margin improved to 57.1% in Q1 FY27 from 55.8% YoY; EBITDA margin 13.9%; operating EBITDA margin 9.1%
items.quote: Gross profit for the quarter stood at Rs. 231 crore, up 19.4% YoY, with gross margin improving to 57.1% in Quarter 1 FY27, from 55.8% in the corresponding quarter last year.

items.statement: Raw material inflation (polyol, TDI) up 70-160% on spot prices, but net inflation only 30-40% due to supplier relationships; passed on via two ~5% price hikes
items.quote: Although it went up 70%, 80%, 160% we actually saw net inflation only by about 30-40% at various points in time when we acquired it. And that is the reason when we passed on the price to end consumer it was two increases of about 5% each approximately.

items.statement: Mattress revenue grew 27.3% YoY (66% of revenue); two-thirds volume, one-third price; furniture to return to mid-to-late teens growth over next two quarters
items.quote: Mattress contributing 65.9%, about 66% for Q1 FY27 revenue with a healthy 27.3% year-on-year growth.

items.statement: Own channels 72.3% of revenue (growing 20.5% YoY); online 52.7%, offline 47.3%; premium mattresses ~15-20% of company sales, ~50% of offline mattress sales
items.quote: Our own channels contributed 72.3% of total revenue, with revenue from these channels growing 20.5% YoY.

items.statement: Full impact of raw material cost increases to flow through H1 FY27; expect ~100 bps gross margin compression in Q2 vs Q1 unless Middle East situation worsens
items.quote: When you look at the overall H1, it might not be more than 100 to 120 basis points unless something else happens in the rest of August and September in terms of driving up the prices.

items.statement: A&P spend to remain 7-8% of revenue for FY27; rental outgo ~Rs. 80-90 crore; ESOP expense Rs. 10-12 crore (lower than earlier Rs. 12 cr guidance)
items.quote: Yes, please because the festive season will also come up now so in that range, it should be this.

items.statement: External marketplace channels grew 7.6% YoY in Q1 after prior declines; benefited from platform growth focus and sale events
items.quote: Our external channels contributed 27.7% of total revenue and delivered 7.6% YoY revenue growth.

items.statement: Jumbo store construction underway: first store targeting June-July 2025, second August-September 2025, both in Bangalore; furniture growth step-jump expected post launch
items.quote: In terms of going live, we target next year June-July for the first store and August-September for the second store, both in Bangalore.

items.statement: Operating EBITDA margin 9.1% in Q1; steady-state target ~7.5% for FY27 given volatility; 16-17% reported EBITDA margin 2-3 years out
items.quote: We should aspire for the same number this year given the huge volatility in all of the things. Channels, competition, raw material prices.

items.statement: Store catchment areas show 2.7x-3x monthly run-rate growth after offline store opening; 36% revenue from repeat/cross-sell customers
items.quote: That catchment area, which includes online and offline, that growth has remained at about 2.7x-3x. So, if a town was at Rs. 3, it is now at Rs.10 per month.

items.statement: Raw material inventory 3-4 weeks; current inventory cost below spot prices; price hikes paused unless unforeseen increases occur
items.quote: We do have about 3-4 weeks of raw material that is parked with us based on different types of raw materials.

items.statement: Management expects to sustain EBITDA per ton of approximately INR75,000 for FY27, depending on product mix, exports, and currency.
items.quote: We therefore believe that we should be able to sustain approximately INR75,000 per ton for FY27, though the actual performance will depend on the product mix, exports, and currency.

items.statement: Management targets export revenue to return to historical peak of around 40% of total revenue over time.
items.quote: And what we have said is over time, so not specifically in this period of this year, the target is to increase it back to its historical peak of around 40% of total revenue.

items.statement: Management aims to reduce net working capital days to 30-35 days, in line with industry standards.
items.quote: But we feel that 30, 35 days is something that is fairly achievable, and that is what our aim in the going forward will be to do better than that also if possible.

items.statement: Phase 2 expansion at Supa is on track for completion by March 2027 with overall project cost of INR150-160 crores, largely funded by IPO proceeds.
items.quote: See the overall project cost for phase two like we had mentioned, part funded through the IPO funds, was around INR150 crores to INR160 crores.

items.statement: Board authorized evaluation of acquiring additional 10 acres of land within Supa MIDC for long-term expansion requirements.
items.quote: our board last night authorized management to evaluate acquiring an additional 10 acres of land within Supa MIDC for its long-term expansion requirements.

items.statement: Entered into a five-year supply framework agreement with Hitachi Energy Global for winding wires to their Indian and global plants; details still being finalized.
items.quote: We are very pleased to announce that we have entered into a five-year supply framework agreement with Hitachi Energy Global to supply winding wires to their Indian plants as well as their some of their global plants.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA per ton was approximately INR93,000, up from INR74,000 in Q4 FY26 and INR66,000 a year ago, driven by record CTC contribution, higher exports, improved utilization, and weaker rupee.
items.quote: In Q1 of FY27, we reported EBITDA per ton of approximately INR93,000 per metric ton, up from roughly INR74,000 in Q4 and INR66,000 a year ago.

items.statement: Trailing 12-month EBITDA per ton was approximately INR74,000; management believes INR75,000 per ton is sustainable for FY27.
items.quote: We reported an EBITDA per ton of approximately INR74,000 for the trailing 12 months period. We therefore believe that we should be able to sustain approximately INR75,000 per ton for FY27.

items.statement: Transformer OEMs have order books of 3-5 years and are expanding capacity; strong demand pipeline in EV motors, AC compressors, DG set alternators for data centers, and localization due to BIS standards.
items.quote: if you look at the T&D side of it, you know, like we mentioned, you know, a lot of the customers locally and globally, we find them, they are sitting on an order book of anything that could be from say, 3 to 5 years.

items.statement: CTC contribution within specialized wires reached record levels in Q1 FY27; 765 kV and HVDC products represent above 25% of CTC volume.
items.quote: In fact, in Q1, CTC's contribution to the total revenue reached record levels in the last several years.

items.statement: Specialized wire revenue grew 113% YoY in Q1 FY27; standard wire revenue grew 83% YoY; overall volume was under 8,000 metric tons, up 30% YoY.
items.quote: Overall, sales volume was a little under 8,000 metric tons in Q1, up from roughly 7,600 metric tons in Q4 and 6,100 metric tons a year ago.

items.statement: Some transformer OEM customers in active capacity expansion mode have delayed order pickups by a few weeks; expected to normalize as bottlenecks resolve.
items.quote: we have seen a few of the transformer OEM customers who are in active capacity expansion mode, delay picking up their orders by a few weeks.

items.statement: Upcast backward integration facility at Chakan commissioned with 5,000 MT capacity to recycle own copper scrap; expected to provide modest operating efficiency and sustainability benefits.
items.quote: Last week, we completed yet another one of our IPO objectives on time by commissioning our upcast backward integration facility in Chakan. This facility will have a capacity of 5,000 metric tons and be used to recycle our own copper scrap.

items.statement: Installed capacity at June 30, 2026 was 43,445 MT; expected to reach roughly 59,000 MT by end of FY27 after Phase 2 completion.
items.quote: once phase two of our Super expansion is complete by the end of this year, this financial year, we would have an installed capacity of roughly 59,000 metric tons.

items.statement: Consolidated utilization improved to 73.5% in Q1 FY27 from 70% in Q4 FY26 on unchanged capacity of 43,445 MT.
items.quote: With capacity unchanged, consolidated company utilization improved to about 73.5% in Q1, up from 70% in Q4 of FY26.

items.statement: Working capital days improved to 60 days in Q1 FY27 from 65 days in Q4 FY26 and 71 days a year ago; further improvement targeted.
items.quote: After showing a five-day average working capital day improvement in Q4, we were able to improve it by another five days in Q1 during Q1, resulting in an average working capital days of 60 days during the quarter compared to 71 days a year ago.

items.statement: Reiterated double-digit revenue growth guidance for FY27
items.quote: For FY27, we reiterate our double-digit revenue growth guidance.

items.statement: DG set order book at INR1,700 crores as of 31st July 2026, with INR900 crores data center orders
items.quote: Within our DG set business powered by Cummins, the order book as of 31st July 2026 stood at INR1,700 crores, providing strong visibility for future growth. Out of this, data center -specific orders within this business stood at INR900 crores.

items.statement: Data center order book increased to INR1,100 crores by August 7th from INR900 crores on July 31st
items.quote: as on July 31st, the data center order book stood at INR900, but literally just in the past week, that order book now, like if you would take August 7th as the timestamp, that number would be 1,100.

items.statement: Genset EBITDA margin impacted in Q1 and part of Q2 due to West Asia crisis, expected to improve from Q3 onward
items.quote: due to West Asia crisis, this will be -- the margin will be impacted for Q1 and part of the Q2. So, so this is the period that where the margin will be subdued, but we believe that from Q3 onward, it is going to improve.

items.statement: Two-phase price hike implemented: small increase mid-Q1, balance at start of Q2; quantum not disclosed
items.quote: we took a two-phase approach. We based on the market conditions and, you kno w, acceptance, feedback from our sales team, etc., we took a small price increase in the middle of Q1, and the balance in the start of Q2.

items.statement: Wind IPP portfolio to grow from 330 MW to 633.55 MW (corrected to 638.35 MW); 50 MW in FY27, 150 MW in FY28, 100 MW in FY29
items.quote: Including above projects, we have clear visibility to take our IPP portfolio to 634 megawatt, or to be more precise, it is 633.55 megawatt. (Wrongly said on call. The correct number is 638.35 megawatt)

items.statement: Data center is fastest-growing segment; manufacturing remains top market segment; rental is second fastest growing
items.quote: data center, of course, is our fastest-growing segment, but manufacturing still continues to be our top market segment in terms of percentage, and that's followed by real estate. The second fastest growing is the rental segment.

items.statement: Wind revenue mix: IPP 11.5%, EPC & O&M 7.1% of Q1 FY27 revenue; DG set 81.4%, Allied 9%, Wind 18.6%
items.quote: Within this segment, the IPP business contributed around 11.5% to Q1 FY27 revenues, while the EPC and O&M for BOP contribute approximately 7.1%.

items.statement: Geopolitical uncertainties and commodity price inflation impacting margins with time lag for cost pass-through
items.quote: As flagged on our last call, the geopolitical uncertainties and e nergy prices have had an impact on our performance. Commodity price inflation weighed on our margins this quarter as there is typically a certain time lag before we can pass rising input costs through to our customers.

items.statement: MSLG pipeline strong with INR41 crore order won, international inquiries resuming, PSU second phase in technical discussions
items.quote: recently, we have won one tender of INR41 crores, which is to be executed between 12 months to 15 months. The others are in pipeline.

items.statement: RECD revenue INR16-17 crores in Q1 FY27, impacted by crisis and GRAP implementation, expected to recover in coming quarters
items.quote: retrofit emission control devices business, it is strong enough, but this time we have we have about 17 crores, 16 crores of a revenue during the quarter, primarily because of one is the crisis, second is on the GRAP implementation, which was there in the Northern Capital.

items.statement: EPC wind business executing ~450 MW currently, adding 250-300 MW annually with ~INR400 crores yearly revenue
items.quote: you can say approximately the top line would be around INR400 crores of the this EPC business.

items.statement: Wind IPP EBITDA margins: new projects 82-83%, old 330 MW projects 62-63%, EPC 10-11%
items.quote: generally, the new projects take comes with the 82 %-83% of the EBITDA level of a total revenue side, and our old projects of 330 megawatts, generally we get 62%-63% of the EBITDA, and in the EPC business, we get generally 10% to 11% of the EBITDA margin.

items.statement: No orders lost due to supply constraints; capacity increases underway across industry to meet data center demand surge
items.quote: I mean, we're not losing any orders or anything because of supply constraints. This is a phenomenon that, every engine maker, every DG supplier is facing, just because -- not supply constraint, but because of how quickly the demand in DCs shot up.

items.statement: Net cash INR193 crores; capital allocated to 300 MW wind projects under construction; open to other deployment opportunities
items.quote: we already mentioned about the 300 megawatt, which is under construction, including 50 will go live this year and 250 new project that we won. So, one is that the capital will be allocated towards that. Further, the we always open to any of the idea that comes into fore.

items.statement: Platino business focus on India due to strong domestic demand; export possibilities to be explored later
items.quote: right now the focus is on India per se because the demand is very strong per se in India. And definitely, as we discussed earlier about the export possibilities which is there, so we will look forward for that, but right now the focus is in India

items.statement: Management says numbers will go up and they will not let them go down, citing strong Q1 and positive response from IPO roadshows.
items.quote: We are really working hard. We will not let the numbers go down anyway. Numbers will be going up as our first quarter you can see.

items.statement: Flagship store in Jaipur requires approximately INR24-25 crores total investment for interiors; land and building already ready.
items.quote: So, approximately we were going for the BOQ with the BOQ, I think it's around INR25 crores will be invested in that. The land is already being procured before. The building is already ready. Now the interior part is happening. I think approximately we wer e counting around INR24 to INR25 crores invested into that in

items.statement: Company-owned boutique stores outside Jaipur estimated at around INR5 crores each excluding inventory.
items.quote: We are calculating in each store around INR5 crores.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 revenue split was 78% B2B and 22% B2C, both driven by bridal demand.
items.quote: So, we had around 78% of B2B in this Q1 as I have come to know, 22% we have done B2C and both the demands were connected to bridals.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin at 33.12% and PAT margin at 23.12%.
items.quote: EBITDA increased 33.02 to INR11.72 crores with a healthy margin of 33.12%, while PAT grew 37.86 to INR8.19 crores with a PAT margin of 23.12%.

items.statement: Gold price locked at order booking with advance; hedged immediately to protect margins; procurement matched to sold stock.
items.quote: Most of the time, it is order booking and when if we get a good advance from the client, we just immediately hedge the gold so that we don't get any kind of fluctuation in our margins and prices.

items.statement: Bridal season growing strongly; Gen Z and millennials driving demand for designer branded jewellery beyond HNIs.
items.quote: Industry is growing. In fact, bridal seasons are growing like anything. People are asking for designer jewellery a lot. We were thinking of only HNIs going for designer jewellery. Now, it's not like that. Everybody wants a taste.

items.statement: Expanding into contemporary men's jewellery and lightweight pret jewellery for Gen Z and millennials alongside core bridal.
items.quote: We are introducing new collections across emerging categories, including contemporary men's jewellery and lightweight pret jewellery. Basically, we deal in bridal jewellery, but now we are starting few more categories of jewellery, that is pret and men's jewellery.

items.statement: Working capital may increase with retail expansion but ample capital available for current plans; will seek funding later if needed.
items.quote: So, working capital requirement may increase, but at this moment, we have ample capital to do the current kind of expansion we are looking for. So, I think this is enough yet. If it is needed later, strategically we will go for more fundings.

items.statement: IPO proceeds used to become debt-free; balance funds (approx INR52-57 crores) held for future expansion and inventory.
items.quote: So, the first thing which was there was getting debt-free, that we are already done. And the balance fund, I think we have around -- I think around we have still -- we have around 52 and the 7, I think it is. So, it's around -- we have a chunk of fund which we have kept for further expansion and there's a amount which is already used for the new inventory made.

items.statement: Flagship store in Jaipur targeting operational by November 2025, delayed by rains; brand ambassador to be announced at launch.
items.quote: Trying to get it done by November, but interior is going on. Let's see what happens. Jaipur is getting good rains. So, the work is getting delayed, but I feel we will be able to get it done by November.

items.statement: Franchise model under development with protocols expected within a month; franchise partner funds inventory (est. INR6-8 crores per store).
items.quote: We are really working hard, I think by a month, we will be ready with our franchise models. What because at this moment, we are not even inviting franchises till the time we are not ready with the strong protocols on that.

items.statement: Inventory can be rotated across company-owned stores; designs easily reworked or recycled if not selling.
items.quote: It can be rotated because it's our own store. So, the best part of this is that the inventory rotation will give us more business. So, that is for sure will be happening.

items.statement: US prioritized for export expansion; also exploring UK and Middle East with exclusive pieces for art-loving UK market.
items.quote: US is anyway a big market, actually. If we talk about UK yes, it's a good market, but I feel US is a bigger market and we are working on some new shows, we are working on some new partners who can do some exhibitions there, private exhibitions there with our stuff.

items.statement: Revenue expected to grow at 15-16% CAGR consistent with last 5 years; EBITDA margins to remain stable
items.quote: we expect the margins to remain stable and the Laser Power & revenues also to grow at a steady level as we have been growing in the last 5 years at around 15% to 16

items.statement: Order book at INR27,884 million as of June 2026 comprising INR14,327 million manufacturing and INR13,557 million EPC
items.quote: Our order book stood at approximately INR27,884 million as of June '26. This comprises of INR14,327 million of manufacturing order and INR13,557 million of EPC order.

items.statement: EBITDA margin improved to 12.6% in Q1 FY27 from 11.5% in Q1 FY26
items.quote: EBITDA grew by approximately 26% to INR659 million, and EBITDA margins improved to 12.6% from 11.5% in Quarter 1 of FY26.

items.statement: HT cables carry 2-3% higher EBITDA margin than normal cables; specialized HTLS conductors expected to fetch higher margins
items.quote: So, it's roughly like 2%, 3% of margin difference between the normal cable and HT cables at EBITDA level. That's how we look at our business, yes.

items.statement: Participated in INR1,250 crores of HTLS re-conductoring tenders out of INR3,500 crores floated in last year; high-voltage cable sales grew from 9% to 29% of revenue in 9 quarters
items.quote: Over the last 1 year, utilities have approximately floated tenders worth INR3,500 crores involving HTLS conductors and re- Laser Power & conductoring. We have participated in approximately INR1,250 crores of these tenders

items.statement: Manufacturing split 90% cables / 10% conductors; HT cables grew from 9% to 29% of revenue in 9 quarters; EPC-manufacturing mix to remain similar
items.quote: In manufacturing division, our cable and conductor split usually between 90% and 10%. And that's how, because till now we are selling those conventional conductors, and with this HTLS segment coming into the picture, that proportion may increase with this specialized conductor.

items.statement: Finance cost absorbed 55% of Q1 EBITDA; INR4,900 million IPO proceeds used for debt repayment; gross debt now INR3,600 million with net debt negligible after INR2,400 million fixed deposits
items.quote: Finance cost absorbed approximately 55% of quarterly EBITDA and remained a principal factor moderating the conversion of operating profitability into PAT.

items.statement: IPO completed July 2026; INR4,900 million proceeds utilized for loan repayment; gross debt reduced to INR3,600 million
items.quote: Approximately INR4,900 million of IPO proceed was utilized towards the repayment of loan outstanding. Gross debt currently stand at approximately INR3,600 million.

items.statement: Interest savings of ~INR40 crores annually at PBT level from debt repayment at ~9% cost of capital
items.quote: So, the interest saving typically our cost of capital is roughly 9%, and we have repaid INR490 crores of debt. So, accordingly, the interest saving will come through, and that should be nearly somewhere INR40 crores in a year at PBT level.

items.statement: Working capital typically 100-120 days; Q1 spike due to EPC project mobilization and FG/WIP inventory buildup of INR90 crores expected to normalize
items.quote: Our working capital typically range between 110 to 120 days, 100 to 120 days, actually. And there could be some spike in a particular reporting date because of various reason, the EPC project at what stage it is.

items.statement: EPC EBITDA margins broadly 15-20% but vary by project milestone timing; not representative of steady run-rate
items.quote: EPC margin roughly stands between somewhere 15% to 20%, but EPC margin can't be look at a particular quarter or at a particular moment, because that will depend on a single project milestone.

items.statement: Manufacturing capacity 85,000 metric tons; utilization ~62% overall, cables ~80%; capacity expanded ahead of demand; can reach 90-95% utilization
items.quote: expanded installed capacity meaningfully over last 3 years, our immediate focus is on improving utilization, increasing the productivity of our existing assets, and growing the contribution from higher value-added products

items.statement: TS Conductors AECC technology patented; carbon core imported from US; Laser manufactures conductor and handles installation in India
items.quote: The technology provider is a US-based company called TS Conductors, and that is the company which manufactures the carbon core, and it is a patented technology, and they produce this carbon core from U.S. and export it to India.

items.statement: Deferred tax benefit of ~INR125-130 crores from carry forward losses to be fully utilized in FY27; normal cash tax from FY28
items.quote: On INR500 crores, the tax saving, entire tax saving would be roughly somewhere INR125 crores, INR130 crores. And for accounting purpose, we are showing that as a deferred tax, but there is no cash outflow since then on my taxes.

items.statement: FY27 revenue growth guided at 45-50% YoY driven by full-year execution of recent orders
items.quote: And we will be doing a revenue growth of about 45% to 50% Y -o-Y. This is driven by full -year execution of orders which we have won recently.

items.statement: FY27 EBITDA growth targeted at 35%+ YoY subject to fuel cost normalization
items.quote: Apart from that, we are targeting to have an EBITDA growth of 35% plus year -on-year subject to fuel cost spikes which we are expecting to normalize.

items.statement: FY27 PAT growth expected at 35%+ YoY reflecting interest cost savings
items.quote: PAT growth we are again expecting to be in the range of 35% plus year-on-year reflecting a margin which will be having because of savings in interest cost as well.

items.statement: Order book stands at INR 9,124 crores including GST as of June 30, 2026 with 46-month average duration
items.quote: Our order book stood robust at INR9,124 crores including GST as of June 30, 2026. Out of the revenue of INR657 crores, INR597 crores, that is approximately 91%, came from coal mining services.

items.statement: Adjusted EBITDA margin for Q1 FY27 is 20.02% after excluding INR 10.57 cr diesel escalation revenue; steady-state margin guided at 23%+
items.quote: However, our revenue for the quarter includes a revenue of INR10.57 crores related to diesel escalation which has been given to us by Coal India. So if we report that, our EBITDA margin stands at 20.02% for this quarter.

items.statement: Diesel prices spiked from INR 90 to INR 154 during Iran war; currently at INR 110-120 range and expected to normalize
items.quote: See, initially the diesel which was at INR90 scaled up to INR112, then in the range of INR130 to INR140, and then it also picked up to INR154 rupees, sir. Now, that same diesel also touched a low of INR98, and then today it is standing at INR110 to INR120 range, sir.

items.statement: FY27 capex planned at INR 450 crores (INR 167 cr cash, INR 283 cr debt) for current orders; no new tenders assumed
items.quote: Sir, if we are talking about the current orders which we have secured, we in the complete year we will be adding up INR450 crores sir. Out of that INR450, INR167 will be in the cash part, sir. So on the loan part if we don't add up any further tender from here on, sir, INR283 will be in the form of loan.

items.statement: IPO proceeds of INR 208 crores used for debt repayment; year-end debt expected at INR 750 crores
items.quote: We started off the year with INR1,024 crores of debt, and we will do some run -down as well in the current year by paying EMIs. And we are ad hoc payment of INR208 crores. So we expect that by year -end we should close at roughly around INR750 crores worth of debt.

items.statement: No slowdown in coal demand; power sector growing daily; contracts not dependent on coal volume but on overburden removal
items.quote: No. We are -- one thing is very clear that there is no weakening demand for coal, because you see the power sector, and power sector is growing every day and demand is growing every day.

items.statement: Actively bidding for 8-10 coal/OB tenders; evaluating iron ore, MDO and critical mineral opportunities
items.quote: We do started bidding for other coal contracts already from last month itself. And there are a couple of contracts -- couple of tenders which are in pipeline right now. We have participated in more than 8 to 10 tenders right now and we are awaiting results. Apart from that, we are actively looking for opportunities in

items.statement: Key scaling risk is maintaining execution discipline and building senior professional team as sites grow from 10 to 15-20
items.quote: Apart from this sir, we will have to keep building up a good, sound, senior professional team which will keep the work at the site happening at the momentum and at the discipline we need sir.

items.statement: Fuel escalation clauses cover 86% of revenue (coal mining); timing mismatch causes partial pass-through; logistics also affected by diesel spikes
items.quote: Sir, a major, if you see 86% of our revenue comes from coal mining. So all our coal mining projects are covered with fuel escalation costs.

items.statement: Credit rating upgraded from BBB+ to A- with positive outlook post-IPO; cost of debt 8.5-9% expected to decline
items.quote: I'm happy to share that we have got one notch improvement from BBB positive to A minus with a positive outlook. The outlook has also been upgraded.

items.statement: Q2 overburden removal target ~34 million cubic meters vs 43.37 in Q1; Q3-Q4 expected to be strongest quarters post-monsoon
items.quote: Sir, the monsoon is a weak quarter for our sector sir. And number 2 sir, as we have done 43 million cubic meter in quarter 1, we wish to do approximately 34 million cubic meter in quarter 2 sir.

items.statement: Turnover grew 4% YoY in Q1 FY27, driven equally by volume and price growth.
items.quote: We recorded obviously INR979 crores, right, of turnover, which was about a 4% growth and backed by volume growth, which was also both volume and value equally split, price growth.

items.statement: Management does not provide forward-looking revenue guidance but remains reasonably optimistic.
items.quote: We don't give forward-looking guidance, right? So I'm not able to give what you're asking for. But we are reasonably optimistic.

items.statement: Underlying PBT grew ~22% YoY in Q1 FY27.
items.quote: The underlying PBT growth, as we have mentioned in the press release, was at about 22% as well, as substantiated by a table in the presentation.

items.statement: Crossed 2,000 EBO stores; aim to reach 3,000 in the future.
items.quote: We also crossed the landmark of 2,000 EBO stores, the first obviously, brand or a banner in the country to cross 2,000. And we now obviously have desire to move towards 3,000 in the coming future.

items.statement: ZBM expanded to ~80% of COCO retail revenue covering ~775 stores; franchise expanded to ~750 stores.
items.quote: ZBM expanded to almost now 80% business contributing stores, close to 800. Franchise expanded to 750.

items.statement: Inventory turns improved to ~2.7x, highest availability levels, full-price sales near 90%.
items.quote: Inventory progress continued year-on-year now for 2 years running. Stock turns are at industry best at about 2.5 plus. In fact, now edging towards 2.7. And this was -- despite that, our availability is at its highest levels. Our full-price sales were very close to 90%, with a continuous uptick over the last 4 or 5 quarters.

items.statement: Raw material cost push of 5-6% offset by similar price increases; margin dilution expected to be neutralised.
items.quote: So broadly, the cost push what we have witnessed is in the range of about 5% to 6%. And as Gunjan mentioned that we have taken a similar price increase to ensure our margins are protected.

items.statement: Hush Puppies and Floatz led growth; Bata grew on ladies category; Power sneakers did well, NorthStar rationalised.
items.quote: Hush Puppies obviously led the charge, along with Floatz, which continues to deliver extremely strong sequential and year-on-year growth rates. Surprisingly, even Bata grew well, right? So, against the trends that were there, it was led by the ladies category, which has done extremely well, backed by the campaign we ran with Taapsee Pannu, as well as the whole Everyday Essential range we launched.

items.statement: Franchise channel growing faster, diluting gross margin by ~100 bps but accretive at EBITDA level.
items.quote: Just to add on what Gunjan mentioned for the current quarter, the channel mix dilution is close to 100 basis points. So if assuming the same channel mix would have been there, the gross margin percent would have seen an improvement of 230 basis points versus 130 basis points what you see.

items.statement: Gross margin expanded 130 bps YoY; would have been 230-240 bps without channel mix dilution.
items.quote: Although gross margin got diluted because of the channel mix, otherwise, we should have seen an uplift of about 230 bps, 240 bps versus the 130 bps what you see right now.

items.statement: Product funnel reimagination to significantly change portfolio by March 2027 with premium, design-led products.
items.quote: By March '27, you should see a significant change in the portfolio of products we are offering to consumers, right, with, as I mentioned, a significant amount of authority from Bata on design and comfort, backed by technology.

items.statement: Vendor consolidation from ~120 to ~60 partners; target 15 core + 15 satellite in 3-5 years, expecting ~200 bps margin benefit over journey.
items.quote: Now we are down to below 70, I think close to 60 or so. We should foresee as we had shared that we should have 15 core as well as a satellite set of another 15, so about 30 broadly in the next about 5-year journey -- 3 years to 5 years journey. Now ideally, over this period of time, this is not the only rationalization. As I've also talked -- responded to another person earlier, we are also ration

items.statement: Annual consolidation savings of ~0.2-0.3% at overall level.
items.quote: And it will take some time. But yes, typically, we have witnessed over a longer period of time, we should have got a delta savings from consolidation at an overall level of about 0.2% to 0.3% at a year-on-year basis, right?

items.statement: Employee costs flat for 5 quarters due to VRS, organisational restructuring, and technology-driven productivity gains.
items.quote: But the VRS did have an impact on employee cost, and that's one of the objectives in the business case for the VRS. The second piece that is also important and that I think the company has been going through that for the last almost 24 months. You can now see in the last 3, 4 quarters, the trend lines on it, which is basically a significant organisational restructuring that we did in terms of a pr

items.statement: Franchise partner ROI 18-24%; like-for-like growth at high single digits for 4 quarters.
items.quote: Broadly, a franchise partner gets in the range of about 18% to 24% ROI. Some are smarter and more efficient, so it gets a little better if they get a good deal in terms of the real estate piece. But 18% to 24% is almost like an underlying floor for a successful partner.

items.statement: Potential franchise trade areas exceed 600; significant expansion runway.
items.quote: We right now have potential trade areas just for franchise, which are in excess of almost 600 right now. So there's a huge, how do you say, belly to fill on that front also.

items.statement: Ad spend up 25% YoY in Q1 FY27; elevated marketing spend to continue for next couple of years to support new product launches.
items.quote: As you can see over the last 3 quarters, our spends have been double-digit growth over last year. Last quarter was 25% more. And I don't see a reason why the next period that is coming ahead, I wouldn't say only the quarters, but even the next couple of years, you will see elevated marketing spends to back up this -- the product range that is coming.

items.statement: A&P expense currently 3-3.5% of sales vs 2.5% a year ago; no immediate shift to 7-8% expected.
items.quote: Right now, you can look at whatever is the current trend line, which would be about between 3%, 3.5% versus about 2.5% a year back. It's not that we want to immediately shift to 7%, 8%, but you can always like look at from 3.5% -- 3%, 3.5% kind of number.

items.statement: Competitive intensity at lower price points uncertain as peers yet to face full raw material cost impact.
items.quote: I think it's too early to comment on it. As Amit mentioned, I think this whole piece, just like us, many others have still not got the full brunt of the raw material price increase; therefore, the pressure on basically realised price from consumers, etc. So I think we'll have to wait and watch.

items.statement: New price stock to hit market at scale by September due to 140-150 days inventory holding.
items.quote: Some of the stocks are yet to hit the markets. As I mentioned, we hold between 140 and 150 days of inventory anyway. So by that time, the new price stock will start hitting the market at a large scale, that would be sometime towards, let's say, September.

items.statement: Roha resin plant commissioned, undergoing stabilization and production ramp-up; expands conventional resin capacity 5x versus pre-Roha baseline.
items.quote: We have all been talking about the Roha facility, where we have shown a picture earlier, which is another part of the plant, where the capacity expansion for our flagship business, the ion exchange resins, has increased by 5x through the setting up of the Roha plant, which is currently commissioned and going through stabilization and ongoing production increase.

items.statement: Pharma resin capacity at Ankleshwar expanding 6x with FDA approval; adds weak acid cation and acrylic anion grades.
items.quote: Our pharma resin factory is FDA approved, and the capacity expansion plan is 6x. And there also, it will help us expand our product portfolio with the new weak acid cation and the acrylic anion resin grades.

items.statement: Membrane manufacturing in Goa targeting 3x business growth; second plant coming up for UF/MBR range with MANN+HUMMEL partnership.
items.quote: Overall, the plan is to have a 3x business growth over the years. And with this kind of a range that we are building in membranes in our Goa facility, the second plant is coming up, we will be the only manufacturer in India to have the full range of integrated membrane facilities in the country.

items.statement: Standard systems factories at Hosur, Goa, Wada expanded multiple times; part of industrial products portfolio scale-up.
items.quote: All the 3 factories across Hosur, Goa, and Wada have had investments being made where capacities have been expanded multiple times.

items.statement: Won 20-year O&M concession contract with Petroleum Development Oman for comprehensive services.
items.quote: Case in point was the order that the company won in Oman with Petroleum Development O man, which was a comprehensive 20 -year O&M contract concession that the company will be executing

items.statement: Zero B home water solutions growing at 30%+ rate; expanded to 700+ cities, 2,000+ trained engineers, and adjacent markets like Nepal.
items.quote: The last part of building scale, you have witnessed that, is through our Zero B home water solutions range, where we have been growing at a significant rate of 30 odd percent, 30% plus.

items.statement: Industrial Products revenue CAGR 9% over last 4 years; slight dip in current year due to West Asia crisis and investments.
items.quote: On the industrial products, again, you will see it is a 9% CAGR. A little bit of softening in the last year, otherwise the numbers would have looked far better. There were some impacts because of West Asia crisis.

items.statement: Lifecycle Services revenue CAGR 10% and EBIT CAGR 21% over last 4 years.
items.quote: On Lifecycle Services, I think a good story. 10% growth in revenue over the last few years. Now that we are reporting these number segments separately, but a very, very positive, healthy 21% growth in CAGR over the year of the last 4 years.

items.statement: Specialty Chemicals and Consumer Products both recorded double-digit top-line growth; Specialty Chemicals EBIT also double-digit; Consumer Products profitability down but targeting break-even this financial year.
items.quote: Both specialty chemicals has recorded double-digit growth in both of their top-line revenue as well as on the profitability EBIT. While consumer products has been a very strong growth story. However, the profitability has been down, and we have talked about how our plan is to come back and break even in this financial year.

items.statement: Post-reclassification, ~60% of company revenue from products, chemicals, services; Treatment Solutions ~40%.
items.quote: We believe that with this reclass ification, about 60% of the company will comprise of products, chemicals, and services, and the treatment solutions will be about approximately about 40% of the company

items.statement: Portugal acquisition margins similar or better than India, varying by segment; consumer products not present there.
items.quote: But I would say that, again, varies segment to segment. We talked about the five segments. The four of the five segments are present there, so not the consumer products business. That varies segment to segment. But overall, the margins will be similar, if not better than what we see in India.

items.statement: Portugal acquisition (MAPRIL) integrated three years ago; teams trained; pursuing solutions projects in South Europe, Iberia, North Africa.
items.quote: So, that business was acquired about three years back. And I think we have completed the integration of that product line, and I think we have got teams well-trained on Ion Exchange products and solutions offering.

items.statement: Roha plant enables shift to high-end specialty resins (pharma, semiconductor, ultra-pure) while maintaining core volumes; rebranded Chemicals to Specialty Chemicals.
items.quote: So, a cross the board, we are moving more towards high -end specialty application grade while continuing to keep the bread -and-butter core volume intact. And that is why we felt that it was possibly time that we classify our chemicals away from commodities to more specialized application offerings

items.statement: Appointed regional leaders for Americas, Asia Pacific, Middle East Africa, Europe; country leaders being added to pursue local market opportunities.
items.quote: we have also appointed a leader for our Asia Pacific business. We have appointed a leader for our Middle East Africa business, and we are in the process of appointing a leader for our Europe business. It is not an Americas effort alone. It is part of a very consid ered effort to take the company global

items.statement: WQA certification obtained for resins to sell in Americas market; certification is mandatory for local regulatory compliance.
items.quote: These markets also require our products to have local certifications to be able to meet the requirements of customers in those local markets as per local stat regulations, and the WQA certifica tion is a step in that regard for our resins

items.statement: Treatment Solutions profitability hit by large legacy projects (e.g., U.P. project) in final execution stages; focusing on selective bidding, better risk profile, and advanced/emerging solutions for premium.
items.quote: It is a mix of both. And we have always called out in past meets and calls that this segment is currently facing headwinds due to some large value legacy projects that we are continuing to execute and finish. I think we have borne a brunt of that pain of those projects as is evident in these numbers.

items.statement: Developing PFAS absorption and destruction technologies (foam fractionation) to address forever chemicals; few global players offer this; polymer resin demand remains strong.
items.quote: There are companies already working. I had talked about this in our emerging solutions in a portfolio where in terms of both absorption through resins and also destruction of those chemicals, we are coming out with technologies which will help us do that. And there are very few companies in the world who can offer that in the market, and we would like to be one of them.

items.statement: 30% revenue from international markets; 14 global manufacturing/assembly facilities; 50+ countries presence.
items.quote: In terms of our global presence, we are present in some 50-plus countries. 30% of the company's revenue come from our international markets. We have 14 global manufacturing and assembly facilities with 200,000-plus installations.

items.statement: Workforce of 3,500+ professionals across 15+ countries; 650+ in EPC/projects, 600+ in products/manufacturing, 1,400+ in consumer/retail.
items.quote: We are a team of about 3,500-plus professionals with competencies and capabilities spread across 15-plus countries, with competencies in EPC and projects, over 650-plus people. In products and manufacturing, over 600-plus people. In consumer and retail, which is our dearly product line, we have about 1,400+ people.

items.statement: Order book stood at INR 2,473 crores as of June 2026, excluding the recent Hyundai contract win of around $52 million announced post quarter-end.
items.quote: Across these three businesses, our order book stood at INR 2,473 crores as of June 2026, providing healthy execution visibility. However, this order backlog d oes not include the recent contract win of Hyundai of around $52 million, which was announced post the closing of the quarter

items.statement: Bid pipeline stood at INR 9,777 crores, providing a strong opportunity funnel for future order inflows.
items.quote: In addition, the bid pipeline stood at INR 9,777 crores, providing a strong opportunity funnel for future order inflows.

items.statement: Expect Roha plant to achieve full capacity over the next four years with asset turnover of just under 2x on manufacturing CapEx, implying at least 50% revenue increase for specialty chemicals over the next couple of years.
items.quote: We had said in the past that we expect once the Roha plant achieves full capacity over the next four years, we should have an asset turnover of just under 2x on the manufacturing CapEx, which we are incurring. So, currently, our specialty chemical, as you just mentioned, is just under INR 900 crore for the year for '25-'26. So, we expect a substantial increase of at least 50% in this capacity over

items.statement: Targeting break-even for consumer products segment in FY27; will discuss single-digit margins after achieving break-even.
items.quote: So our plan is to see if we can break even in this financial year. That is the first target for us. As and when we reach that milestone, we would be in a position to talk about what kind of single-digit margins we are talking about.

items.statement: Continue to hold 25% utilization guidance for Roha plant in first year of operation; will reassess by end of Q2 FY27.
items.quote: So, we continue to hold on, ma'am. This is about four months of the year gone. It has been softer than what we expected. But at this point in time, we are not throwing in the towel. We are still holding on and working with our teams in the overseas geographies and with our plants to see that we are able to meet the guidance. If and when, I think by the end of the second quarter, we will be in a be

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA declined 49% YoY to INR 32 crores with margin at 4.54% in Q1 FY27.
items.quote: For the first quarter under review on a consolidated basis, the company reported an operating income of INR 701 crores, increase of 20% year-on-year. The EBITDA stood at INR 32 crores, which declined by 49% year-on-year. The EBITDA margin stood at 4.54%.

items.statement: Treatment solutions segment reported EBIT loss of INR 17 crores in Q1 FY27, impacted by legacy projects.
items.quote: The treatment solutions segment reported a revenue of INR 210 crores, an increase of 14% year-on-year. The Segment reported an EBIT level loss of INR 17 crores, with profitability continues to be impacted by certain legacy projects.

items.statement: Industrial products segment EBIT margin improved significantly to 11.89% from less than 6% in Q1 FY26, with EBIT increasing 145% to INR 13 crores.
items.quote: The industrial products delivered a strong performance during the quarter, with revenue growing 14% year-on-year to INR 105 crores. The segment EBIT margin increased by 145% to INR 13 crores, while EBIT margin improved significantly to 11.89% from less than 6% in the corresponding quarter of last year.

items.statement: Lifecycle services EBIT margin was 9.92% vs 10.55% in Q1 FY26, primarily reflecting higher input costs.
items.quote: The Lifecycle Services maintained its healthy growth trajectory, with revenue increasing 28% year-on-year to INR 72 crores. The segment EBIT stood at INR 7 crores, an increase of 22% year-on-year. EBIT margin was 9.92% as compared with 10.55% in the previous year, Primarily reflecting higher input cost.

items.statement: Specialty chemicals segment EBIT declined 52% YoY to INR 22 crores in Q1 FY27, impacted by geopolitical factors and higher Roha facility costs.
items.quote: Moving to the specialty chemicals, revenue for the quarter stood at INR 230 crores, an increase of 21% year -on-year. The segment EBIT stood at INR 22 crores, reflecting a decline of 52% year-on-year. Profitability during the quarter was impacted by the geopoliti cal factors as well as higher costs associated with the Roha facility

items.statement: Consumer products segment loss narrowed to INR 34 lakhs from INR 45 lakhs in Q1 FY26, showing modest improvement.
items.quote: Lastly consumer product s delivered strong top -line growth, with revenue increasing 33% year-on-year to INR 112 crores. The segment reported a loss of approximately INR 34 lakhs, compared with a loss of INR 45 lakhs in the corresponding quarter last year, reflecting a modest improvement in Profitability

items.statement: Roha plant impact on specialty chemicals segment margin was approximately 6% at segment level in Q1 FY27.
